title: Director, Government Relations
description_html:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

The Role

As the Director of Government Relations at Fanatics, you work closely with our leadership team to ensure we remain at the forefront of legislative trends and industry developments. In this role, you will provide strategic insights, advocate for our interests, and drive initiatives that reflect Fanatics' commitment to innovation, consumer satisfaction, and the evolving retail landscape. The Director of Government Relations reports to the SVP, Head of Fanatics Global Government Relations team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Forge and Maintain Strategic Relationships: Cultivate and sustain high-impact relationships with key government officials—including Governors, State Attorneys General, and key state and local level policymakers,—to advance Fanatics’ priorities.
  • Provide Executive-Level Legislative Intelligence: Keep Fanatics leadership informed with timely, in-depth analyses of current and proposed legislation affecting the retail, sports, sports betting, and e-commerce sectors, ensuring proactive and informed decision-making.
  • Shape Policy and Drive Advocacy: Monitor the legislative and regulatory landscape, assess potential business impacts, and develop tailored, forward-thinking strategies that position Fanatics for success.
  • Craft Persuasive Policy Communications: Develop compelling policy documents, including executive summaries, position papers, and advocacy briefs, that clearly articulate Fanatics’ policy positions to key stakeholders.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration: Manage external consultants, engage internal stakeholders, and oversee special projects that align with and advance Fanatics’ policy and business objectives.
  • Advocate with Authority: Present Fanatics’ policy positions to government officials, trade associations, coalitions, and industry stakeholders, ensuring alignment between corporate priorities and broader legislative and market trends.
  • Strengthen Industry Influence: Enhance partnerships with trade associations, advocacy groups, and community organizations, reinforcing Fanatics' role as a thought leader in the retail and sports ecosystem.
  • Innovate and Push Boundaries: Develop and execute creative advocacy strategies that challenge the status quo and unlock new opportunities for Fanatics in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.
  • Showcase Fanatics’ Impact: Organize immersive site visits, retail events, and media engagements for elected officials to deepen their understanding of Fanatics’ business model, innovation, and community contributions.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Policy Expertise & Thought Leadership: Deep understanding of public policy, with the ability to distill complex regulatory issues into clear, actionable insights.
  • Extensive Experience in and understanding of the Legislative and Regulatory Process is required. 10+ years of state legislative, state executive government, or state government affairs experience in Washington, including meaningful experience including working across the aisle.
  • Political Acumen & Agility: Highly adaptable, with the ability to anticipate and respond to shifting political and regulatory landscapes.
  • Political Campaign and Electoral Experience highly valued.

title: Staff Data Scientist - Quora
description_html:
[Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company. This position can be performed remotely from multiple countries around the world. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.]

About Quora:

Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

  • Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

  • Poe: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.

About the Team and Role:

The Data Team is highly empowered at Quora, helping navigate complexity and influencing product and company strategy directly. Quora's outsized commitment to data is visible in everything we do, from our sophisticated experimentation processes to the backgrounds of our leaders. With this emphasis on data and empirics, we aim to balance rigor and pragmatism, searching for scrappy solutions in pursuit of our mission. In joining Quora's strong data team, you'll both benefit from and help advance our culture of rational decision making.

As a member of our team, you'll work closely with product managers, product designers, engineers, and other cross-functional partners to devise appropriate measurements and metrics, design randomized controlled experiments, build visualizations, and tackle hard, open-ended problems that uncover usage patterns and opportunities across Quora. Quora has a wide range of rich data, giving you ample room for exploration and creativity.

Data scientists at Quora work across multiple domains, including user growth, content quality, monetization, personalization, marketplace dynamics, and long-term company strategy. Example projects include modeling long-term growth, improving the relevance and personalization of the homepage feed, analyzing drivers of user engagement and question-asking behavior, optimizing marketplace efficiency, and evaluating the effectiveness of monetization initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Own ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces across product and business domains, from question framing, to devising and conducting the analysis, to developing and implementing solutions with cross-functional partners

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and company leadership to shape product strategy and anticipate future challenges

  • Design and evaluate experiments to measure the impact of product and strategic changes

  • Analyze data from across the product to uncover root causes of metric movements

  • Develop tools, methodologies, and frameworks that help make both the data team and the company as a whole smarter about data

  • Multiply the impact of other data scientists through mentorship and instilling industry best practices across the team

Minimum Requirements:

  • Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)

  • 7+ years work experience in an analytical or quantitative role, including 5+ as a Data Scientist or similar title, with a track record of success at a senior or staff level of scope and autonomy

  • Demonstrated ability to tackle difficult data questions that few others could have taken on, such as those requiring deep ownership of a product area and/or leading cross-functional and cross-team efforts

  • Expertise with statistical techniques (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, causal inference) and their practical application

  • Experience mentoring other data scientists and raising team standards through best practices and process improvements

  • Effective communication skills, including the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into analytical questions and to explain technical results to executives and cross-functional partners

  • Extensive experience using a procedural programming language (e.g. Python, R) for data manipulation, modeling, and analysis; comfort working in a production codebase

  • Strong judgment that blends quantitative rigor with product intuition and common sense

Preferred Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience evaluating recommender systems in offline analysis and online experiments

  • Experience setting technical direction or strategy for a team or major workstream

  • Experience with large data sets and distributed computing tools (e.g. Presto/Trino)

  • Active Quora user with curiosity about the product

At Quora, we value diversity and inclusivity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, including marginalized or underrepresented groups in tech, to apply for our job openings. We encourage all candidates who share a passion for growing the world’s knowledge, even those who may not strictly meet all the preferred requirements, to apply, as we know that a diverse range of perspectives can have a significant impact on our products and our culture.

Additional Information:

We are accepting applications on an ongoing basis. This role is a backfill for an existing vacancy.

Quora offers a wide range of benefits including medical/dental/vision coverage, equity refreshers, remote work reimbursement, paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more. Benefits are country-specific and may vary.

There are many factors that will determine the starting pay, including but not limited to experience, location, education, and business needs.

  • US candidates only: For US based applicants, the salary range is $163,560 - $240,092 USD + equity + benefits.

  • Canada candidates only: For Toronto and Vancouver based applicants, the salary range is $210,013 - $246,625 CAD + equity + benefits. For all other locations in Canada, the salary range is $196,012 - $230,183 CAD + equity + benefits.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

AI technology may assist in sorting applications and recording interview notes, but all decisions are made by a member of our team.

To ensure a secure hiring process, all final candidates will undergo identity verification and a comprehensive background check prior to onboarding.

Job Applicant Privacy Notice: https://www.careers.quora.com/pages/quora-global-job-applicant-privacy-notice

title: Manager, Enterprise Partnerships - Financial Services
description_html:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

The Role

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform, and partnerships are a core lever for accelerating growth across loyalty, financial services, and payments. The Enterprise Strategic Partnerships team sits at the enterprise level, working across Fanatics Commerce, Collectibles, and Betting & Gaming to develop and execute high-impact partnerships that create value for fans, partners, and operating companies.

We are seeking a Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Business Development Operations to support and scale our business development efforts across new loyalty partnerships (e.g., airlines and hotels), expansion of Fanatics’ financial services strategy (credit and debit), and large strategic partnerships with payments companies and digital wallets.

This role is ideal for a strong operator with BD instincts — someone who can manage complex deal processes end-to-end, coordinate across a decentralized organization, and also step into partner-facing conversations when needed. You will work closely with senior BD leaders while owning much of the operational and executional backbone that turns ideas into launched partnerships.

What You’ll Do:

Business Development Operations & Execution

  • Manage the enterprise partnerships pipeline across loyalty, payments, and financial services, including opportunity tracking, stage gating, and prioritization
  • Support business case development for new partnerships, including economics, customer value, partner value exchange, and operational feasibility
  • Own project management for new partnership launches, coordinating across product, legal, finance, risk, loyalty, marketing, and operating companies
  • Help operationalize complex partnerships in a decentralized, multi-opco environment, ensuring alignment and clear ownership across teams
  • Support ongoing partner management post-launch, including cadence, performance tracking, and issue resolution

Partner-Facing & Deal Support

  • Develop sales and pitch materials for prospective partners, including decks, operating models, and value propositions
  • Participate in partner meetings and pitches, presenting defined sections such as partnership structure, loyalty mechanics, or operational approach
  • Support negotiation and deal structuring alongside senior BD leaders, particularly around payments, loyalty conversion, and financial services consideration
  • Help translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and execution plans

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years of experience in business development, partnerships, strategy & operations, fintech, payments, loyalty, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of loyalty ecosystems, including earn/burn mechanics, currency conversion, and coalition-style partnerships
  • Familiarity with the payments ecosystem from a merchant perspective, including how transactions flow across wallets, networks, issuers, processors, and platforms
  • Experience supporting or executing complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and long timelines
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to build and communicate clear, ROI-driven business cases
  • Highly organized, execution-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguity
  • Clear communicator who can distill complex concepts for both internal and external audiences
  • A “general athlete” mindset — intellectually curious, adaptable, and willing to roll up sleeves where needed
  • Passion for sports and excitement about Fanatics’ mission and platform

Why This Role Matters

This role is a force multiplier for Fanatics’ enterprise partnerships strategy. You’ll help ensure that big, strategic partnership ideas actually turn into launched, scalable programs — while building the experience and exposure needed to grow into a more senior deal-leading role over time.

Achieving our goals requires strong collaboration and partnership between our teams and our internal stakeholders. To best support this, the person who accepts this role is expected to be on site, in office four days per week. To provide our employees with flexibility, we offer a unique benefit where employees at Fanatics' corporate entity can work remotely for up to four weeks per year, which can be taken in daily or weekly increments.

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$138,000—$168,000 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Principal Product Manager, Ads
description_html:
About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is hiring a Principal Product Manager, Ads to reimagine and build an advertising solution for the next generation of our platform.

TeamSnap today has a scaled advertising business. For years, top national and regional brands have reached millions of youth sports families through the TeamSnap app. What's next is building an ad product for where we're going. As we bring our millions of parents, coaches, and players onto a new, unified TeamSnap experience, the ads business gets rebuilt with it, from a blank slate.

This is a unique and rare product opportunity. You'll be rebuilding advertising at a company that has already proven the demand — real advertisers, real revenue — and playing the lead role in deciding what the future of advertising looks like at TeamSnap. The formats, the placements, the measurement, and the standards that keep all of it worthy of the families who trust us and deliver on our advertisers' objectives.

You'll own the product side of that ad platform end to end — partnering with Design on native ad experiences, with Engineering on the serving and measurement infrastructure, and with our Ad Sales team on the inventory and packaging they take to market. You'll report to VP Product and work closely with senior leaders across the company on one of TeamSnap's top strategic priorities.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the advertising product roadmap end to end — from ad format and placement strategy through serving infrastructure, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

  • Design and launch native, integrated ad experiences in partnership with Product Design. Our thesis is that ads on TeamSnap should feel like part of the product and drive value for both our consumer users and advertisers.

  • Own the serving and targeting stack: ad server implementation, trafficking and campaign delivery workflows, private marketplace deal setup, and the first-party signal work that makes our inventory worth buying — getting the right context to the ad call so it can be used for targeting.

  • Build the measurement foundation: impression and viewability tracking, event instrumentation, third-party verification where advertisers require it, advertiser-facing reporting, and the experimentation framework to improve placements and creative over time.

  • Own ad quality, density, and user experience standards — where ads appear, how often, and what we won't do.

  • Partner with Ad Sales and Revenue Operations to turn product capability into sellable inventory — packaging, the targeting taxonomy they sell against, rate card inputs, and campaign delivery and pacing.

  • Model and forecast the business. Build the volume, fill rate, and eCPM models that tell us which placements are worth building, and what has to be true for a given format to pay for itself.

  • Own privacy and compliance requirements for ad targeting and data use, in partnership with Legal — including how children's data is treated, given the families we serve.

  • Work in ambiguity. Break down an undefined space into a sequenced plan, make practical tradeoffs between revenue, engineering cost, and user impact, and bring partners along with a clear point of view.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 7-10 years in product management, with meaningful time spent on the publisher/supply side of the ads ecosystem — building and monetizing ad inventory inside a consumer product.

  • Direct experience launching or scaling ad products in a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android), including the platform-specific realities: SDK integration, ATT and IDFA, store policy, app release cycles, and how those constrain what you can ship and when.

  • Deep, hands-on technical fluency with the publisher ad stack: ad server implementation and trafficking (Google Ad Manager or equivalent), programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace deals, key-value and audience targeting, ad SDK integration, VAST and video formats. You should be able to hold your own in an engineering design review.

  • Command of the economics: fill rate, eCPM, RPM, sell-through, viewability, latency, and how each moves in response to product decisions. Comfortable pricing inventory without an auction to tell you what it's worth. You can build the model yourself and defend the assumptions.

  • Experience working alongside a direct ad sales organization — translating between what sales wants to sell and what the product can actually deliver, and building the packaging that closes the gap.

  • Demonstrated judgment about ads and user experience. A track record of shipping monetization that didn't degrade the product, and clear thinking on where the lines belong.

  • Strong data instincts. Comfortable in product analytics tools (Amplitude or similar) and SQL-adjacent enough to interrogate your own funnels rather than waiting on someone else to.

Bonus:

  • Experience with rewarded video, pre-roll, or other video monetization formats.

  • Background in a subscription business where advertising had to coexist with a paid tier without cannibalizing it.

  • Working knowledge of children's privacy regimes — COPPA and its state-level equivalents — as they apply to advertising.

  • First-party data and audience signal work: building the pipeline that carries publisher context into targeting decisions.

  • Familiarity with sports, media, or a community-driven consumer platform.

Compensation

Additional Information

Got cold feet? If you're thinking you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We're all humans with special talents that go beyond what's listed here.

Compensation

We're committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $180,000 inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

Total Rewards

• We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - US
description_html:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Why This Role Matters

Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools.

This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster.

You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast.

What You'll Do

GTM Analysis & Decision Support

  • Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers.

  • Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff.

  • Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach.

Data Modeling & Quality

  • Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system.

  • Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking.

Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics

  • Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software.

  • Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it.

  • Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests.

  • Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself.

How You'll Work

  • Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager.

  • Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it.

  • Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data.

  • Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work.

  • Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data.

  • Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome).

BI & AI Fluency

  • Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches.

  • Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale.

  • We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty.

Mindset

  • Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning.

  • Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle.

  • Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often.

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

description_html:
Wir sind ein junges Consulting Unternehmen und beraten Marken bei der Erschließung & Optimierung von Amazon als Vertriebs- und Marketingkanal. Wir machen internationale Top Marken auf Amazon sichtbar, indem wir Premium SEO Content entwickeln, Promotionen (Cyber Week, Prime Day) nutzen und umfangreiche Performance Marketing Maßnahmen einführen. Wir unterstützen aber auch lokale Traditions- und Familienbetriebe dabei, auf Amazon erfolgreich zu verkaufen und sich so im globalen Wettbewerb zu behaupten. So leisten wir unseren Beitrag zur erfolgreichen digitalen Transformation kleiner und mittelständischer Unternehmen in Deutschland. Und so kannst Du mithelfen:

Aufgaben

Das erwartet dich:

  • Du erstellst visuell ansprechende Grafiken und Designs für Amazon-Listings, die Produkte optimal präsentieren und die Aufmerksamkeit der Kunden wecken.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Content-Team zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produktbilder und -videos den hohen Qualitätsstandards entsprechen und die Markenbotschaften effektiv kommunizieren.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von kreativen Konzepten für Werbekampagnen, Promotionen und andere Marketingmaßnahmen.
  • Du gestaltest die kompletten Produktdetailseiten, den Brand Store und Werbekampagnen unserer Kunden.
  • Du pflegst und überarbeitest bestehende Designs, um die Konsistenz und Qualität der visuellen Auftritts auf Amazon zu gewährleisten.

Qualifikation

Was solltest du mitbringen?

  • Du studierst Grafikdesign, Visuelle Kommunikation, Mediengestaltung oder bist interessierte QuereinsteigerIn mit relevanter Erfahrung im 1. , 2. oder 3. Semester.
  • Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Interesse und Gespür für visuelle Gestaltung, Designtrends und Ästhetik.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine Hands-On Mentalität sowie zielorientiertes Arbeiten aus.
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und findest Spaß daran, eigene Ideen zu entwickeln und in die Wirklichkeit umzusetzen.
  • Du beherrschst die gängigen Grafikdesign-Tools (z.B. figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Affinity Designer etc.) und hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen im Bereich E-Commerce oder Online-Marketing.

Benefits

Was bieten wir dir?

  • Flache Hierarchien, offene Türen und schnelle Übernahme von Projekten, denn bei uns trägt jeder Verantwortung.
  • Mobiles und kollaboratives Arbeiten mittels moderner digitaler Plattformen.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell: “design your work around your life”.
  • Arbeitsumfeld mit Start-up Charme - Lounge, Terrasse, Tischtennis, Siebträger Kaffeemaschine, Free Drinks.
  • Attraktiver Standort direkt beim SI-Centrum Stuttgart mit sehr guter Anbindung an Bahn, Bus und Autobahn, eigene Parkplätze stehen zur Verfügung.
  • Home-Office-Möglichkeit.
  • Firmenausflüge und Teamevents.
  • Wir sind ein ❤- liches und motiviertes Team und mehr als einfach nur Kollegen.

Werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams! Wir freuen uns auf dich! Du hast Fragen, Ideen oder Wünsche? Melde dich jederzeit!

title: Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rochus Mummert digital GmbH
description_html:
Unser Mandant ist ein traditionsreiches Unternehmen mit Sitz in Mülheim an der Ruhr. Die mittelständisch geprägte Kultur zeichnet sich durch direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, pragmatische Zusammenarbeit und einen hohen Anspruch an Verlässlichkeit und Selbstorganisation aus. Zu Verstärkung der Finanzabteilung suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d).

Aufgaben

  • Als Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Finanzbuchhaltung eigenständig und übernehmen die fachliche sowie organisatorische Führung des Teams. Sie arbeiten als „mitarbeitende Führungskraft“ auch inhaltlich bei den Abschlüssen mit, Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt jedoch auf Organisation, Qualitätssicherung, Prozessverbesserung und der adressatengerechten Aufbereitung von Informationen für das Management.
  • Sie führen und organisieren die Finanzbuchhaltung fachlich und organisatorisch und steuern die Aufgaben inhaltlich.
  • Sie verantworten Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, plausibilisieren Abschlusspositionen und Entwicklungen und stellen eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.
  • Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit mit Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Steuerberatungen und weiteren externen Ansprechpersonen und klären bilanzielle Sachverhalte in Abstimmung mit der Leitung Finanzen.
  • Sie entwickeln Management-Reportings und buchhaltungsbezogene Analysen weiter, untersuchen Plan-Ist-Abweichungen, Cashflow- und Ergebnisentwicklungen und bereiten Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management auf.
  • Sie etablieren und überwachen Rechnungslegungs-, Dokumentations- und interne Richtlinien sowie Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Qualitätssicherung und Fehlerprävention.
  • Sie übernehmen als wichtiges Startprojekt die Auswahl und Einführung einer neuen Finanzbuchhaltungs- beziehungsweise ERP-Lösung mit dem Ziel, wiederkehrende Abläufe möglichst weitgehend zu standardisieren und zu automatisieren.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, eine Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.
  • Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen sowie Erfahrung in einer fachlich oder organisatorisch führenden Funktion mit.
  • Sie verfügen über sehr gute HGB-Kenntnisse und fundierte Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, bei Abschlussprozessen sowie in der Plausibilisierung und Analyse von Abschlusspositionen.
  • Sie arbeiten sicher mit ERP- beziehungsweise Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen und Excel und bringen idealerweise Erfahrung in der Analyse und Modellierung von Finanzdaten mit.
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbstständig, verlässlich und diskret, verfügen über eine hohe Zahlen- und Qualitätsaffinität und treffen professionelle Einschätzungen auch bei komplexen Sachverhalten.
  • Sie kommunizieren komplexe Inhalte klar und adressatengerecht mit Management, internen Schnittstellen, Wirtschaftsprüfungen und externen Beratungen; gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab.

Benefits

  • Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition an der Schnittstelle zwischen operativer Finanzarbeit und Management.
  • Sie gestalten die Organisation, Qualitätssicherung und Digitalisierung der Finanzbuchhaltung aktiv mit und begleiten die Einführung einer neuen Finanzbuchhaltungs- beziehungsweise ERP-Lösung.
  • Sie arbeiten in einem traditionsreichen, familiengeführten Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und wertschätzender Unternehmenskultur.
  • Sie profitieren von 30 Urlaubstagen, Vertrauensarbeitszeit und bis zu zwei Tagen mobilem Arbeiten pro Woche.
  • Ein attraktives Konditionenpaket und ein strukturiertes Onboarding und eine umfassende Einarbeitung runden das Angebot ab.

Ihr Kontakt

Sie möchten Verantwortung übernehmen, die Finanzbuchhaltung zukunftsorientiert weiterentwickeln und als Bindeglied zwischen Finanzprozessen und Management nachhaltige Verbesserungen schaffen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Ein aussagekräftiger Lebenslauf genügt zunächst.

title: Fachkraft für Schädlingsbekämpfung (m/w/d) | 2.700 - 3.600 €/Monat + Firmenwagen zur Privatnutzung
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Riverstate Premium Recruiting
description_html:
Auf der Suche nach neuen beruflichen Chancen? Dann könnte dieses Angebot sich für Sie lohnen! Eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit, ein Jahreseinstiegsgehalt von bis zu 43.000€, ein Dienstwagen zur privaten Nutzung inklusive Tankkarte, Urlaubsgeld, Provision und Spesen, vielfältige Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten und vieles mehr.

Als Servicetechniker in der Schädlingsbekämpfung betreuen Sie einen festgelegten Kundenstamm und sind hauptsächlich zuständig für das Aufstellen, Kontrollieren und Entsorgen hochmoderner Fallen. Dabei müssen Sie sich die Hände nicht schmutzig machen – der Schwerpunkt liegt mehr auf Service als auf Schädlingsbekämpfung.

Sie erhalten zum Start eine umfassende Schulung, die Ihnen alles nötige Know-how an die Hand gibt und Ihnen selbstverständlich in voller Höhe vergütet wird. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt als

Fachkraft für Schädlingsbekämpfung (m/w/d) | 2.700 - 3.600 €/Monat + Firmenwagen zur Privatnutzung

Aufgaben

  • Sie betreuen eigenständig einen festgelegten Kundenstamm
  • Sie stellen Bekämpfungs- und Prophylaxe-Konzepte zur Schädlingsbekämpfung im Gesundheits- und Vorratsschutz auf: Ratten, Mäuse, Bettwanzen, Schaben usw. – der Fokus liegt dabei auf giftfreien, digitalen Technologien
  • Sie übernehmen regelmäßige Schädlingskontrollen bei Vertragskunden verschiedener Branchen und die damit zusammenhängende digitale Dokumentation
  • Sie führen gelegentlich Maßnahmen zur Taubenabwehr, Reinigung und Desinfektion durch

Qualifikation

  • Sie sind geprüfte Fachkraft für Schädlingsbekämpfung (IHK)
  • Sie sind kommunikativ, höflich und kundenorientiert
  • Sie haben sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)
  • Sie haben einen Führerschein der Klasse B

Benefits

  • Keine Vorkenntnisse erforderlich: Um als Servicetechniker in der Schädlingsbekämpfung durchzustarten, brauchen Sie weder ein abgeschlossenes Studium noch eine Ausbildung. Vor Antritt der Tätigkeit erhalten Sie Schulung, in der Sie alles Notwendige lernen. Die Schulung wird Ihnen bereits mit vollem Lohn vergütet.
  • Sorgfältige Einarbeitung: Bevor Sie selbstständig auf Tour gehen, begleiten Sie nach der Schulung zunächst einen erfahrenen Servicetechniker bei seiner alltäglichen Arbeit. Anschließend sind Sie gewissermaßen Ihr eigener Chef und betreuen Ihre Kunden in Eigenregie und mit großen Freiheiten.
  • Top-Konditionen: Zum Einstieg verdienen Sie bei entsprechender Erfahrung bis zu 2.900 € im Monat, bei Top-Qualifizierung sogar mehr! Zudem erhalten Sie einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte zur privaten Nutzung sowie Urlaubsgeld, Mobiltelefon und iPad, auch zur privaten Nutzung, Spesen und vermögenswirksame Leistungen.
  • Krisenfest und stabil: Sie arbeiten nicht nur in einem interessanten, abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsgebiet, sondern erhalten auch einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einer krisensicheren und wachsenden Branche. Ihr Job ist langfristig sicher.
  • Großartige Entwicklungschancen: Über die hauseigene Akademie in Hamburg bieten sich Ihnen vielfältige Fortbildungsangebote, ob Servicetechniker mit IHK-Abschluss, Desinfektor oder Teamleiter – Ihnen stehen viele Wege offen.
  • Arbeitsatmosphäre: Die Unternehmenskultur zeichnet sich durch Offenheit, Kollegialität und kurze Entscheidungswege aus. Sie arbeiten ausschließlich mit den neuesten Innovationen und digitalen Systemen. Regelmäßige Teamevents sorgen für eine gute Stimmung.

Bewerben Sie sich am besten jetzt gleich. Wir melden uns anschließend telefonisch bei Ihnen und begleiten Sie kompetent und zuverlässig durch den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess.

Unsere Beratung ist für Sie völlig kostenlos. Falls Sie Fragen haben, erreichen Sie Ihre persönliche Ansprechpartnerin Julia Schneider unter +49 155 600 651 73.

title: Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rochus Mummert digital GmbH
description_html:
Unser Mandant ist ein traditionsreiches Unternehmen mit Sitz in Mülheim an der Ruhr. Die mittelständisch geprägte Kultur zeichnet sich durch direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, pragmatische Zusammenarbeit und einen hohen Anspruch an Verlässlichkeit und Selbstorganisation aus. Zu Verstärkung der Finanzabteilung suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d).

Aufgaben

  • Als Leiter:in Buchhaltung (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Finanzbuchhaltung eigenständig und übernehmen die fachliche sowie organisatorische Führung des Teams. Sie arbeiten als „mitarbeitende Führungskraft“ auch inhaltlich bei den Abschlüssen mit, Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt jedoch auf Organisation, Qualitätssicherung, Prozessverbesserung und der adressatengerechten Aufbereitung von Informationen für das Management.
  • Sie führen und organisieren die Finanzbuchhaltung fachlich und organisatorisch und steuern die Aufgaben inhaltlich.
  • Sie verantworten Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, plausibilisieren Abschlusspositionen und Entwicklungen und stellen eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.
  • Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit mit Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Steuerberatungen und weiteren externen Ansprechpersonen und klären bilanzielle Sachverhalte in Abstimmung mit der Leitung Finanzen.
  • Sie entwickeln Management-Reportings und buchhaltungsbezogene Analysen weiter, untersuchen Plan-Ist-Abweichungen, Cashflow- und Ergebnisentwicklungen und bereiten Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management auf.
  • Sie etablieren und überwachen Rechnungslegungs-, Dokumentations- und interne Richtlinien sowie Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Qualitätssicherung und Fehlerprävention.
  • Sie übernehmen als wichtiges Startprojekt die Auswahl und Einführung einer neuen Finanzbuchhaltungs- beziehungsweise ERP-Lösung mit dem Ziel, wiederkehrende Abläufe möglichst weitgehend zu standardisieren und zu automatisieren.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, eine Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.
  • Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen sowie Erfahrung in einer fachlich oder organisatorisch führenden Funktion mit.
  • Sie verfügen über sehr gute HGB-Kenntnisse und fundierte Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, bei Abschlussprozessen sowie in der Plausibilisierung und Analyse von Abschlusspositionen.
  • Sie arbeiten sicher mit ERP- beziehungsweise Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen und Excel und bringen idealerweise Erfahrung in der Analyse und Modellierung von Finanzdaten mit.
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbstständig, verlässlich und diskret, verfügen über eine hohe Zahlen- und Qualitätsaffinität und treffen professionelle Einschätzungen auch bei komplexen Sachverhalten.
  • Sie kommunizieren komplexe Inhalte klar und adressatengerecht mit Management, internen Schnittstellen, Wirtschaftsprüfungen und externen Beratungen; gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab.

Benefits

  • Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition an der Schnittstelle zwischen operativer Finanzarbeit und Management.
  • Sie gestalten die Organisation, Qualitätssicherung und Digitalisierung der Finanzbuchhaltung aktiv mit und begleiten die Einführung einer neuen Finanzbuchhaltungs- beziehungsweise ERP-Lösung.
  • Sie arbeiten in einem traditionsreichen, familiengeführten Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und wertschätzender Unternehmenskultur.
  • Sie profitieren von 30 Urlaubstagen, Vertrauensarbeitszeit und bis zu zwei Tagen mobilem Arbeiten pro Woche.
  • Ein attraktives Konditionenpaket und ein strukturiertes Onboarding und eine umfassende Einarbeitung runden das Angebot ab.

Ihr Kontakt

Sie möchten Verantwortung übernehmen, die Finanzbuchhaltung zukunftsorientiert weiterentwickeln und als Bindeglied zwischen Finanzprozessen und Management nachhaltige Verbesserungen schaffen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Ein aussagekräftiger Lebenslauf genügt zunächst.

  • Sie haben sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

Benefits

  • Keine Vorkenntnisse erforderlich: Um als Servicetechniker in der Schädlingsbekämpfung durchzustarten, brauchen Sie weder ein abgeschlossenes Studium noch eine Ausbildung.   • Großartige Entwicklungschancen: Über die hauseigene Akademie in Hamburg bieten sich Ihnen vielfältige Fortbildungsangebote, ob Servicetechniker mit IHK-Abschluss, Desinfektor oder Teamleiter – Ihnen stehen viele Wege offen.
  • Arbeitsatmosphäre: Die Unternehmenskultur zeichnet sich durch Offenheit, Kollegialität und kurze Entscheidungswege aus. Sie arbeiten ausschließlich mit den neuesten Innovationen und digitalen Systemen. Regelmäßige Teamevents sorgen für eine gute Stimmung.

Bewerben Sie sich am besten jetzt gleich. Wir melden uns anschließend telefonisch bei Ihnen und begleiten Sie kompetent und zuverlässig durch den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess.

title: Senior Business Development Representative (UK)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at LOGEX
description_html:
Help shape the future of healthcare with data

At LOGEX, we're on a mission to improve healthcare through data-driven insights. Every day, hospitals and healthcare organizations across Europe use our solutions to increase efficiency, improve quality of care, and make better decisions.

As we continue our rapid expansion in the UK market, we're looking for a Senior Business Development Representative who thrives on creating opportunities, building relationships, and generating new business within the healthcare sector.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing international health-tech company and play a key role in accelerating our commercial growth in the UK.

What you'll do

As a Senior Business Development Representative, your primary mission is to create qualified sales opportunities for our commercial team.

You will proactively identify, engage, and nurture prospects across NHS Trusts, private healthcare providers, and other healthcare organizations.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Generating high-quality outbound leads through targeted prospecting activities

  • Building and executing strategic outreach campaigns across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels

  • Identifying key decision makers and understanding their challenges and priorities

  • Qualifying opportunities and managing the early stages of the sales process

  • Collaborating closely with Account Executives and Marketing to maximize pipeline creation

  • Conducting market research to identify new growth opportunities

  • Maintaining accurate prospect and activity data within our CRM

  • Representing LOGEX professionally in meetings, conferences, and industry events

  • Consistently achieving and exceeding pipeline generation targets


What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who is highly motivated, commercially driven, and passionate about creating opportunities.

You have:

  • 4+ years of experience in Business Development, Sales Development, Lead Generation, or a similar outbound sales role

  • A proven track record of generating pipeline and booking meetings with senior stakeholders

  • Strong prospecting and outreach skills

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building capabilities

  • Experience with modern sales tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Outreach or similar platforms

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

  • A structured and data-driven approach to sales development

  • Fluency in English

Experience within healthcare, SaaS, health technology, data analytics, or consulting environments is considered a strong advantage.

Why LOGEX?

Healthcare faces major challenges. Rising costs, workforce shortages, and increasing demands require smarter decision-making. LOGEX supports healthcare organizations with actionable data and analytics that enable meaningful improvements for patients and providers alike.

When you join LOGEX, you'll become part of an international team of experts who are passionate about making healthcare better.

We offer:

  • A meaningful role with direct impact on healthcare outcomes

  • The opportunity to help drive LOGEX's ambitious growth in the UK market

  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial, and international working environment

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure

  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

  • Modern equipment and tools to help you succeed

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Payter B.V.
description_html:
We are growing rapidly and constantly expanding our global contactless payment

ecosystem. To support this momentum, we are looking for a Software Development

Engineer in Test to play a crucial role in delivering our key software solutions. Joining a

close-knit engineering team, you will not just write tests—you will champion a quality-first

mindset from day one.

You will collaborate closely with domain owners to deliver high-quality, clean, and testable

code in line with our core strategies. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated SDET

who is ready to advocate for best practices, build resilient automation frameworks, and

ensure our scalable software thrives within a secure cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities

● Design, build, and deliver sustainable, scalable, reliable, and well-tested software

into a secure cloud infrastructure.

● Advocate for and implement testing best practices across all disciplines, promoting a

quality-driven and testable mindset within the team.

● Foster a collaborative environment where everyone shares the responsibility for

quality and testing from the very outset of a project.

● Guide the team during planning and refinement sessions to accurately understand

and estimate test efforts and identify dependencies.

● Pair with Software Engineers during development and code review to ensure

appropriate test coverage at all levels and avoid any duplication of efforts.

● Develop and maintain robust tools for integration, regression, load, performance, and

security testing, ensuring our automation framework is targeted, efficient, and

resilient.

● Investigate and determine the root cause of complex issues by analyzing logs,

databases, and system behavior.

About Payter

At Payter, we are innovators, pioneers, and leaders in the dynamic realm of

unattended/self-service contactless and cashless payment technology in a wide range of

markets such as Electrical Vehicle Charging, Transportation, Retail, Hospitality, Vending,

Charity, Parking, and beyond. The adaptable Payter platform accommodates a diverse

range of payment technologies (NFC, EMV, ApplePay, GooglePay, etc.), international

banking processes, closed-loop payment and loyalty schemes, and telemetry.

Through continuous innovation and in-house development, we redefine how vendors

connect with their customers, empowering them to boost revenue, enhance user

experiences, and access real-time sales and performance data. We support a broad range

of technologies, from Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth, Touch

Screens and more. Our state-of-the-art products have an extremely long service life, are of

high quality, compliant with multiple international standards, boast great design, are

user-friendly for all, multifunctional, and easy to integrate.


● You have a strong track record of advocating for modern software testing practices

and mentoring engineers to build a healthy, automation-first testing culture.

● You possess deep experience developing and maintaining automated test suites

across the entire testing pyramid, including unit, component, integration, end-to-end,

load, and performance testing.

● You are highly proficient in diverse testing strategies (TDD, BDD, Black/White Box),

alongside mocking/stubbing, test data management, and test results reporting.

● You have hands-on experience with native Golang testing packages and UI

frameworks like Playwright. (Note: If you are proficient in another language, we will

train you as long as you are committed to learning Golang!)

● You are experienced with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices (including Infrastructure

as Code), and cloud platforms like GCP, alongside a strong understanding of

event-based, distributed microservice architectures and containerization.

● You have a solid grasp of core software engineering fundamentals (Git workflows,

OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns) and software security practices (vulnerability

assessments, penetration testing).

● You are a highly organized, analytical problem-solver with excellent verbal and

written communication skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for sharing

knowledge and delivering work you take pride in.

What We Offer

● Competitive salary and a discretionary bonus based on company performance

● 25 days of annual leave plus UK bank holidays

● Dedicated monthly “well-being days” to support mental health and work-life balance

● Attractive company pension plan

● Fully remote working environment with a focus on flexibility

● Opportunities for high-impact growth within an international scale-up in the payments

industry

title: (Senior) Product Engineer (Backend) (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Jobgether
description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a (Senior) Product Engineer (Backend) (m/f/d) based in United Kingdom.

Join a product-focused engineering team building AI-powered experiences for frontline employees across retail, manufacturing, and logistics.
You will take deep ownership of backend systems while staying connected to the complete user journey and product experience.
The role combines backend engineering, SaaS development, product thinking, and practical use of AI-powered development tools.
You will work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and AI.
Rather than simply implementing predefined tickets, you will help understand user problems, shape solutions, prototype ideas, and measure their impact.
The environment values curiosity, adaptability, engineering judgment, and continuous learning as software development evolves through AI.
You will have the support and autonomy to expand your technical scope while becoming an increasingly product-minded, AI-enabled engineer.


Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain reliable and scalable backend services for SaaS products.

  • Build APIs, data models, integrations, and other backend capabilities using Kotlin or Java and modern web frameworks.

  • Take ownership of features from problem discovery and prototyping through development, rollout, and impact measurement.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and AI.

  • Extend beyond backend development when needed, contributing to web, mobile, infrastructure, or other areas to deliver complete product experiences.

  • Use AI coding assistants and modern development tools to explore unfamiliar codebases, accelerate development, and make well-structured cross-stack changes.

  • Focus on user outcomes rather than simply completing predefined technical tickets, using conversations, prototypes, instrumentation, and experimentation to validate ideas.

  • Contribute to technical decisions, engineering practices, code quality, and scalable product architecture.

  • Participate in an evolving engineering culture focused on end-to-end ownership, rapid experimentation, and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional experience in backend software engineering, with openness to candidates ranging from a few years of experience to senior-level engineers.

    • Strong hands-on experience with Kotlin or Java and a web framework such as Micronaut or Spring.

    • Experience developing SaaS products, ideally in an Agile or cross-functional product environment.

    • Strong backend engineering fundamentals combined with an interest in contributing outside the backend stack when a product feature requires it.

    • Familiarity with AI-powered coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools, or a strong willingness to adopt them.

    • A product-minded approach, with the ability to understand user problems, evaluate potential solutions, and take ownership through delivery and rollout.

    • Strong curiosity, adaptability, communication skills, and engineering judgment.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and engineers across multiple technical disciplines.

    • Experience working directly from design mockups or prototypes is a plus.

    • Knowledge of instrumentation and experimentation tools or practices, such as A/B testing, Grafana, or Mixpanel, is advantageous.

    • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm is a plus.

    • Practical experience with PostgreSQL is beneficial.

    • Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ or Apache Kafka is advantageous.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote-first working model with the flexibility to work from home.

      • Option to work remotely from within the European Union.

      • Occasional team events, workshops, and meetings at offices in Berlin or Stuttgart, planned with advance notice.

      • Flexible work-life balance and support for an active lifestyle through an E-Gym-Wellpass membership.

      • Job bike leasing.

      • Regular team events and culture days designed to strengthen collaboration and team connection.

      • Relaxed and collaborative working environment with highly motivated colleagues.

      • Opportunity to play an active role in shaping a rapidly growing technology company.

      • Support and development opportunities to deepen technical expertise while expanding product and AI engineering capabilities.

      • Inclusive workplace welcoming people regardless of gender, age, sexual identity, background, religion, worldview, or disability.

How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

title: Mobile Phone & Device Repair Technician
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Stellar
description_html:
Stellar Global is looking for a skilled Mobile Phone and Device Repair Technician to join our team at Samsung KX, King's Cross, London!
 
About Samsung KX:
Samsung KX was launched, in collaboration with Stellar Global, in 2019. Based in Kings Cross, London, Samsung KX is their impressive flagship European brand experience space and Stellar is responsible for managing and developing its exceptional people. Designed to give guests the ultimate immersive brand experience, Samsung KX is a place where people are invited to discover, interact with and learn new skills in a dynamic environment through a range of workshops, events and performances together with local community partners.


Overall purpose of the role:
As a Support Technician you will be involved in the entire repair journey; from the moment the front of house specialist books in a device by responsibly managing stock and part orders, correctly diagnosing faults, conducting Level 2 repairs with 100% functionality, ensuring real time service tracking against KPI, performing in/out quality controls and completing out of box checks. Your role will have a strong focus on repair technology, and you will be responsible for the second part of the customer’s repair journey. Whilst working in collaboration with an enthusiastic team you will develop your skills in troubleshooting, level 1 and level 2 repairs, back of house admin, stock management and customer communication.
 
By working effectively with your team and managing the repair journey you will contribute to the team's repair KPIs. You will furthermore be responsible for determining the warranty status of devices and provide insurance possibilities for out of warranty repairs. You will need to log claims in our own systems and take payments where warranty has expired. You will carry the responsibility for ensuring repairs always happen to the highest standards and that the stock is sufficient to enable yourself and the team to do so.
About Stellar Global:
Stellar Global is a progressive, inclusive retail experience agency that believes in the power of people. By investing heavily in its staff, Stellar is able to deliver a best-in-class service for physical, virtual or hybrid retail experiences. By providing bespoke, immersive training programs and opportunities to flourish and progress, Stellar Global is committed to creating a culture of community and support while cultivating outstanding retail experience specialists.

Stellar is an an Equal Opportunities Employer. We value diversity and inclusion, and all applications are considered equally.

What we are looking for:
  • Experienced in dealing with different working environments i.e. fast paste / quick turn over repairs
  • Experienced in dealing with Samsung phone repairs at level 2
  • Experience working on repairs individually but also within a team
  • Some experience with customer complaints on aftercare and alterations
  • Liaising with different departments to meet specific customer needs
  • Inventory management / Stock
  • Working towards specific deadlines & KPI targets

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive salary
  • 37.5 hours contract, 5 days per week, Mon-Sun
  • Samsung work phone
  • Discount at Samsung members only website
  • 21 days annual leave + Bank Holidays (and 1 extra day following the completion of 1 year of service)
  • Health cash plan via Medicash
  • Great staff benefits

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Social Media Marketing (bis zu 20 h/pro Woche)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Simba Computer Systeme GmbH
description_html:
Gestalte heute mit uns, was morgen zählt – mit Teamgeist, Köpfchen und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam Lösungen zu schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen. Bei Simba findest du ein Umfeld, das auf klare Prozesse, echtes Miteinander und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung setzt – fachlich und menschlich.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Social Media Marketing bist du Teil unseres Marketings und arbeitest daran, die Sichtbarkeit und Positionierung von Simba weiter auszubauen. Du entwickelst Inhalte und Kampagnen, denkst dich in verschiedene Zielgruppen ein und bringst kreative Ideen auf den Punkt – digital, analog und immer im Austausch mit angrenzenden Bereichen wie Produktmanagement, Vertrieb und HR.

Auf dich wartet ein Team, das sich gegenseitig den Rücken freihält, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, dich einzubringen – mit dem, was du kannst und dem, was du noch lernen willst.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann bewirb dich beim #TeamSimba und lass uns zusammen mehr erreichen!

Aufgaben

  • Social Media Experte: Du hilfst uns Strategien für unsere Social Media Kanälen (z.B. LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook) zu entwickeln und gemeinsam mit uns umzusetzen
  • Employer Branding & Social Recruiting: Du unterstützt aktiv den Ausbau unserer Arbeitgebermarke und entwickelst kreative Maßnahmen, um neue Talente für uns zu begeistern.
  • Content Creator: Du erstellst ansprechenden Content, der gezielt Zielgruppen anspricht
  • Community Manager: Du baust und pflegst unsere Social Media Netzwerke und formst mit uns unsere Arbeitgebermarke
  • Performance Analyst: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse der Reichweite und Performance unserer Social Media Kampagnen und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab
  • Kommunikationsprofi: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Fachbereichen wie HR, Vertrieb und Entwicklung zusammen, um ansprechenden Content zu erstellen

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung: erste praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Personal oder Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Social Media
  • Gern gesehen: Erfahrung mit der Creativ Cloud (insbesondere Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom oder Premiere Pro), CapCut, verschiedenen Social Media Kanälen, Erstellen von Content und im Bereich SEO-Optimierung
  • Persönlichkeit: hohe Eigeninitiative, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Zuverlässigkeit und Freude am Themenbereich Personal und Social Recruiting
  • Ausbildung: eingeschriebener Student/eingeschriebene Studentin mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich Marketing, Personal, Unternehmenskommunikation oder ähnliche passende Studiengänge
  • Sprachkenntnisse: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Onboarding: fundierte und professionelle Einarbeitung, sowie enge Begleitung durch einen Boardingpartner
  • Ausstattung: modern und ergonomisch ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, hochwertige IT-Ausstattung
  • Work-Life-Balance: flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Zeiterfassung und Gleitzeitkonto, gesetzliche Urlaubsanspruch, Option auf mobiles Arbeiten und viel Flexibilität für dein Studium
  • Gehaltspaket: attraktives und leistungsgerechtes Gehalt mit Entwicklungsperspektive
  • Mitarbeiterangebote: Kostenlose Getränke und leckeren Kaffee, Corporate Benefit Programm, Team-Events, sowie individuelle Angebote in unseren Niederlassungen (Eis-Flatrate im Sommer, Kanu-Tour oder Whiskey Tasting)
  • Weiterentwicklung: stetige Weiterentwicklung und gezielte Förderung der persönlichen – und fachlichen Skills
  • Unternehmenskultur: offene Feedbackkultur, flache Hierarchien, kollegiale Du-Kultur, ein wertschätzender Umgang und die Möglichkeit dich aktiv mit deinen Ideen bei uns einzubringen

Bei Rückfragen zur Position oder unserem Bewerbungsprozess stehen wir dir gerne zur Verfügung.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Social Media Marketing (bis zu 20 h/pro Woche)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Simba Computer Systeme GmbH
description_html:
Gestalte heute mit uns, was morgen zählt – mit Teamgeist, Köpfchen und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam Lösungen zu schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen. Bei Simba findest du ein Umfeld, das auf klare Prozesse, echtes Miteinander und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung setzt – fachlich und menschlich.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Social Media Marketing bist du Teil unseres Marketings und arbeitest daran, die Sichtbarkeit und Positionierung von Simba weiter auszubauen. Du entwickelst Inhalte und Kampagnen, denkst dich in verschiedene Zielgruppen ein und bringst kreative Ideen auf den Punkt – digital, analog und immer im Austausch mit angrenzenden Bereichen wie Produktmanagement, Vertrieb und HR.

Auf dich wartet ein Team, das sich gegenseitig den Rücken freihält, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, dich einzubringen – mit dem, was du kannst und dem, was du noch lernen willst.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann bewirb dich beim #TeamSimba und lass uns zusammen mehr erreichen!

Aufgaben

  • Social Media Experte: Du hilfst uns Strategien für unsere Social Media Kanälen (z.B. LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook) zu entwickeln und gemeinsam mit uns umzusetzen
  • Employer Branding & Social Recruiting: Du unterstützt aktiv den Ausbau unserer Arbeitgebermarke und entwickelst kreative Maßnahmen, um neue Talente für uns zu begeistern.
  • Content Creator: Du erstellst ansprechenden Content, der gezielt Zielgruppen anspricht
  • Community Manager: Du baust und pflegst unsere Social Media Netzwerke und formst mit uns unsere Arbeitgebermarke
  • Performance Analyst: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse der Reichweite und Performance unserer Social Media Kampagnen und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab
  • Kommunikationsprofi: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Fachbereichen wie HR, Vertrieb und Entwicklung zusammen, um ansprechenden Content zu erstellen

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung: erste praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Personal oder Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Social Media
  • Gern gesehen: Erfahrung mit der Creativ Cloud (insbesondere Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom oder Premiere Pro), CapCut, verschiedenen Social Media Kanälen, Erstellen von Content und im Bereich SEO-Optimierung
  • Persönlichkeit: hohe Eigeninitiative, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Zuverlässigkeit und Freude am Themenbereich Personal und Social Recruiting
  • Ausbildung: eingeschriebener Student/eingeschriebene Studentin mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich Marketing, Personal, Unternehmenskommunikation oder ähnliche passende Studiengänge
  • Sprachkenntnisse: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Onboarding: fundierte und professionelle Einarbeitung, sowie enge Begleitung durch einen Boardingpartner
  • Ausstattung: modern und ergonomisch ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, hochwertige IT-Ausstattung
  • Work-Life-Balance: flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Zeiterfassung und Gleitzeitkonto, gesetzliche Urlaubsanspruch, Option auf mobiles Arbeiten und viel Flexibilität für dein Studium
  • Gehaltspaket: attraktives und leistungsgerechtes Gehalt mit Entwicklungsperspektive
  • Mitarbeiterangebote: Kostenlose Getränke und leckeren Kaffee, Corporate Benefit Programm, Team-Events, sowie individuelle Angebote in unseren Niederlassungen (Eis-Flatrate im Sommer, Kanu-Tour oder Whiskey Tasting)
  • Weiterentwicklung: stetige Weiterentwicklung und gezielte Förderung der persönlichen – und fachlichen Skills
  • Unternehmenskultur: offene Feedbackkultur, flache Hierarchien, kollegiale Du-Kultur, ein wertschätzender Umgang und die Möglichkeit dich aktiv mit deinen Ideen bei uns einzubringen

Bei Rückfragen zur Position oder unserem Bewerbungsprozess stehen wir dir gerne zur Verfügung.
