  • Value-creation strategy: Develop a structured value creation plan to prioritize high impact growth levers for partners, while owning the full sales pipeline from prospecting and negotiating commercials to bringing campaigns live and scaling them.
  • Reactivation & Account Optimization: Systematically diagnose why paused or underperforming accounts are missing their full potential. You’ll build and execute tailored commercial and technical recovery plans collaborating with internal teams and clients to close performance gaps and bring advertisers back to scale.
  • New Vertical Launches: Take new verticals from idea to first revenue, mapping demand, understanding geo, payment and legal framework, and landing the first reference partners.
  • RevOps & Enablement: Run "special" projects that make the commercial org faster, from automating manual workflows to codifying best practices and playbooks for the Account Management team.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with Product, Marketing, Legal & Compliance, Finance and Account Management to unblock deals, shape integrations and hand over accounts cleanly once they're live.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Build the business case yourself, model deal economics i.e. CPI, ROAS, revenue share, LTV and use performance data to structure partnerships that work for the partner and for exmox.
  • Product Voice & Advocacy: Translate what you hear in the market into prioritized, revenue-driving requirements for the roadmap.


What You Bring

  • Relevant Experience: 7+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or B2B sales, with a proven history of personally initiating and closing high-impact deals.
  • "Swiss Army Knife" Profile: You're a builder and a generalist. You're as comfortable opening a new market as you are documenting a process, and you don't wait for someone to define the scope for you.
  • Commercial Hunter Mentality: A "sales-driven" personality obsessed with moving the needle; you are constantly asking "how can we double these numbers?" to drive exponential growth.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Highly analytical, comfortable in spreadsheets and BI tools, able to turn raw performance data into a commercial argument and a clear next step.
  • Process & Automation Instinct: You notice repetitive work and remove it. Hands-on experience with CRM, no-code automation or AI tooling to scale your own output and the team's is a strong plus.
  • Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English with the interpersonal "spine" to challenge partners' assumptions and stand your ground during tough negotiations.
  • Ambitious & Goal-Oriented: A self-starter with high "eagerness" who doesn't just meet targets but proactively seeks ways to exceed them.
  • Nice to have: Management consulting background (e.g., Bain, BCG, McKinsey) combined with business development for a tech scale up.
  • Nice to have: Sales experience within adtech, gaming, rewarded user acquisition industry.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. “Not my job” isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

description_html:
Short title

Build brand communities on social media


Introduction

You don't just manage social media, you shape how brands show up on it. As a Senior Social Media Manager at Pulse Advertising, you lead multi-platform strategies for global brand accounts, drive creative direction, and set the standard for platform-native excellence. You know what's about to peak on TikTok before it peaks, and you're as strong creatively as you are strategically, ideating concepts in a client workshop and owning their execution the next day. You're a trusted senior partner to clients and a go-to voice internally, someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just outputs. If you're ready to lead at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and impact, this is your next chapter.


Your tasks

  • You own TikTok-first content strategies for key global brand accounts, defining platform-native formats, content pillars, and creative direction that drive measurable engagement and business results

  • You lead content planning and execution across TikTok, Reels, Stories, and complementary formats, ensuring every channel feels native, intentional, and on-brand

  • You manage social media across multiple brands within a single parent account, adapting global content frameworks for regional markets with a particular focus on DACH

  • You act as a senior client partner, steering projects from briefing to delivery, proactively shaping agendas and challenging briefs that don't align with platform or audience reality

  • You track, synthesise, and present performance data, translating complex analytics into sharp client-ready insights and actionable recommendations

  • You mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute to pitches and new business proposals, bringing your platform expertise to grow both the team and the account base


Your skills

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in social media management with a clear TikTok focus, including proven results across global or multi-market brand accounts- ideally in consumer goods, home appliances, or lifestyle hardware

  • You think in TikTok: trend cycles, FYP mechanics, algorithm behaviour, and the instinct to know what feels native versus what kills engagement

  • You are comfortable operating within multi-brand account structures and familiar with global-to-local content models, managing competing brand identities across markets without losing quality or speed

  • You are a hands-on creative with the ability to concept campaign ideas and translate them into platform-native formats that resonate with audiences and impress clients

  • You are experienced with Canva, video editing tools, and social analytics platforms and actively use AI tooling to scale your work

  • You are confident leading senior client relationships, communicating platform logic clearly, managing expectations and influencing decisions at stakeholder level.

  • You are fluent in both German and English 


Our Benefits

  • Time to pack your bags for Paris, London, Milan, Hamburg or Berlin: you’re welcome to work abroad from any of our office locations

  • We love to see you grow: our careers coach is on hand for one-to-one coaching sessions and team workshops

  • We work hard and play hard, bringing our global team together to collaborate, learn from one another and celebrate our successes

  • Don’t fancy the office today? Our hybrid remote policy lets you work from home two days a week

  • Keep your commute to a minimum: you’ll find all our offices right in the city centre

  • For motivational high-paws and comforting cuddles, your four-legged friend is absolutely welcome at our offices

title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering

description_html:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Site Reliability Team, you'll help build and maintain world-class infrastructure to meet the needs of millions of users protecting their privacy online. You'll utilize high-level languages like Perl, Go, TypeScript, or Python and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Ensuring our Duck.ai product meets our reliability standards and minimizing user friction on failures

  • Scaling up our own index infrastructure to handle billions of documents

  • Create anti fraud verifications that respect users privacy

 

As Director, Site Reliability Engineering, you'll dive deep into complex operational challenges, including software, systems, automation, and process analysis. We are looking for candidates who can read, write, troubleshoot, and deploy all types of software to help us tackle the reliability challenges of large-scale deployments.

 

About You

  • 10+ years relevant professional experience in reliability, platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including 4+ years leading SRE teams.

  • Experience participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation for a large-scale deployment.

  • Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact and complex projects from proposal through postmortem.

  • Proficient in AI-driven development, including designing and implementing agentic workflows

  • Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics.

  • Experience developing effective tools, services, alerts, and responses to identify and address reliability risks.

  • Investigative ability to root-cause sources of instability in high-traffic, distributed systems.

  • Deep experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and web technologies.

  • Ability to implement automation around infrastructure provisioning and configuration management to prioritize efficiency, scalability, and reliability.

  • Foresight to help identify the future technical direction of our deployment with the goal of improving reliability and performance.

  • Advanced programming skills enabling close partnership with software engineers to triage production issues and identify appropriate remediation, including code changes and performance considerations.

  • Ability to leverage cloud-native services and architectures to enhance reliability and scalability, with hands-on experience packaging and deploying applications using Docker and Docker Compose.

Compensation

$243,800 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Didomi
description_html:
Senior Product Designer

Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting seven Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it.

You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most.

What you'll do

  • Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our external creative agency for UI polish.
  • Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact.
  • Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities.
  • Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on.
  • Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass.
  • Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea.
  • Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work.
  • Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation.

Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain.

We don't expect candidates to meet every point above. If most of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll bring

TBC

description_html:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

Customer Success Consultant - Mirakl Ads (Munich)

About the role

Launched three years ago, Mirakl Ads is Mirakl's global Retail Media technology, empowering eCommerce and Marketplace operators to run successful and profitable Retail Media programs. Now entering a new phase of scale, Mirakl Ads is expanding its client base, developing its media offering, and accelerating its impact across key markets worldwide.

As an Experienced Customer Success Consultant for Mirakl Ads, reporting to the Director of Customer Success, your primary mission is to support Mirakl Ads clients in launching and growing their advertising revenues - from strategy design to day-to-day performance optimization. The ideal candidate is a driven, curious and client-obsessed professional, who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments and brings the energy and structure needed to turn ambition into results.

 

What you will do at Mirakl

The Experienced Customer Success Consultant will have a strong impact on Mirakl Ads growth, managing a portfolio of key clients across all stages of their journey.

  • Lead clients from strategy to implementation: define their Retail Media vision and Mirakl Ads roadmap, design the right organizational setup, co-build a sharp commercial action plan with the right KPIs, and drive execution - ensuring a successful and lasting integration of Retail Media into their business, from first workshops through go-live and beyond
  • Deliver strategic recommendations at business reviews, presenting to client teams and C-levels, sharing market insights and case studies to inspire performance and long-term growth
  • Design and implement the right KPI frameworks to monitor clients' advertising network performance and continuously identify growth levers
  • Support clients in the day-to-day optimization of their Mirakl Ads use (placements, campaign configuration, etc.), ensuring platform adoption and maximizing advertising revenues
  • Lead tailored workshops and training sessions to ensure optimal onboarding and sustained platform mastery over time

 

As part of a growing and structured team, you will also:

title: Talent Acquisition Lead

description_html:
YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager, you take ownership of the entire hiring lifecycle across multiple business functions. You partner closely with hiring managers and senior leadership to attract exceptional talent, improve hiring quality, and build scalable recruiting processes that support long-term business growth.

You combine strong recruiting expertise with a strategic mindset, using data, market insights, and stakeholder management to continuously optimize how hiring decisions are made. Beyond filling positions, you help shape the overall Talent Acquisition function by introducing better structures, improving candidate experience, and strengthening our employer brand.

This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys operating hands-on while building the recruiting foundations of a fast-growing organization.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment across technical, product, commercial, and business functions, managing the full hiring process from kick-off to offer acceptance.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring strategies, challenge role requirements, and support workforce planning.

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve recruiting processes, including intake meetings, interview structures, scorecards, feedback quality, and hiring governance.

  • Develop proactive sourcing strategies across different talent markets, adapting your approach for technical, commercial, and go-to-market roles.

  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, networking, referrals, and market mapping.

  • Use recruiting data and market insights to identify bottlenecks, improve hiring performance, and provide transparent reporting on key recruiting metrics.

  • Create dashboards and reporting structures covering pipeline health, conversion rates, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and overall hiring performance.

  • Manage and challenge external recruiting partners, ensuring high-quality delivery, clear expectations, and efficient collaboration.

  • Drive employer branding initiatives by improving candidate communication, supporting hiring managers, strengthening social media presence, and enhancing the overall candidate experience.

  • Contribute to the continuous development of the Talent Acquisition function by introducing scalable structures, automation opportunities, and best practices.

WHO YOU ARE

We welcome different career paths, including:

  • 6+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or Executive Search within fast-growing technology, SaaS, e-commerce, marketplace, or digital businesses.

  • Strong experience recruiting technical profiles, combined with the ability to successfully hire commercial, sales, marketing, and other business functions.

  • Proven experience managing full-cycle recruitment independently across multiple seniority levels.

  • Experience building or significantly improving recruiting processes, hiring frameworks, dashboards, and operational recruiting structures.

  • Strong sourcing capabilities with confidence engaging passive candidates across competitive talent markets.

  • Data-driven mindset with experience using recruiting metrics to improve hiring quality, stakeholder decisions, and overall process efficiency.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the confidence to advise, influence, and constructively challenge senior leaders.

  • Experience working with external recruiting agencies, executive search partners, or freelance recruiters.

  • Strong interest in employer branding and candidate experience, with the ability to strengthen an organization's visibility in the talent market.

  • Highly structured, proactive, and hands-on working style with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-changing environments where building structure is just as important as executing day-to-day recruiting.

  • Fluent in both German and English.

title: Head of Customer Experience
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at comstruct ICT
description_html:
The mission:

comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures, along with top European investors.

 
 

About the role 🦺

As our Head of Customer Experience you own the entire post-sales journey of our customers. You lead a team that covers everything from Solution Engineering and POV Implementation through Rollout and Adoption to Expansion and Support. Your mission: flawless rollouts and a customer experience that makes comstruct the operating system of every construction site.

 

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Build and lead the CX org: You hire, develop and coach the team across the entire customer experience journey. From scoping ERP architectures in Solution Engineering to resolving requests in Support. You set the structure, the standards and the pace.

  • Make technical rollouts a machine: POVs, supplier integrations, on-site onboardings and multi-site rollouts - you turn what's currently craftsmanship into a scalable system that gets customers to value in weeks, not quarters.

  • Own the post-sales P&L: You tie customer health to ARR, run strategic QBRs with enterprise decision makers and build the engine that surfaces qualified expansion signals before Sales ever gets involved.

  • Shape the product from the field: You sit in Engineering and Product sprint meetings, drive roadmap prioritization from customer signals and make sure what gets built is what moves accounts forward.

     

What we're looking for ✨

  • You bring 3-5 years of experience in Solution Engineering, Implementation, Value Engineering or Customer Success in enterprise or mid-market environments with high implementation complexity. Structuring POV execution and scoping complex technical implementations across multiple stakeholders is your core, not a secondary skill.

  • You have led a team for at least 1-2 years, hiring and developing ICs, in an environment where the playbook didn't exist until you wrote it.

  • You don't need to code, but you can read and map an ERP integration, assess what's feasible and push back in a room full of engineers.

  • You are eager to learn the product from scratch and understand it inside out. You drive roadmap prioritization from the field and connect customer feedback to what actually gets built.

  • You have carried commercial ownership in a previous implementation or GTM role. You've qualified upsell, defended pricing and driven expansion.

  • You handle multi-layered enterprise accounts, tough stakeholder conversations and direct feedback without losing composure.

  • You speak German on a native level and are fluent in English.

Nice to have: Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; hands-on building of features or integrations; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch.

 

Why join comstruct? 🛠️

Construction is one of the largest and least digitized industries in the world. We're building its digital future. Founded in March 2022, we've raised a €12.5M seed round from 20VC, Google Ventures and top European investors and nine of Switzerland's ten largest contractors already run on comstruct. That's the foundation. The category-defining company gets built now - together with you!

 

What we offer

  • Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan.

  • Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CEO Henric Meinhardt, plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC.

  • Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware.

  • Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company.

  • Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca and Italy.

comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. What you’ll do:

As a GTM Associate, you play a mission-critical role in the growth of comstruct. You are the main driver of your segment and therefore a key contributor to our overall revenue success. As the first point of contact for potential customers, you set the foundation for high-quality deals and long-term customer relationships.

What you’ll do:

  • You are the engine that keeps comstruct growing. Without pipeline there are no deals, no customers, no company. This is your responsibility.

  • Leverage AI agents, automations, and creative strategies to reach prospects nobody else has found yet.

  • You identify new markets, develop your own approach and execute it. No playbook handed to you. The market is yours to open.

Topics you will be working on:

Hunt the Market

Getting into a market is one thing. Your job is to make sure we leave no contractor behind - find every qualified buyer in our existing markets before anyone else gets there.

Market Development

You will identify which segments, regions, and buyer types to go after next, build your own strategy and execute it. Your goal is to open markets that did not exist in our pipeline before you touched them.

Agentic Outreach

    • Free drinks, snacks, and daily optional dinners

title: Operations Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at GALVANY
description_html:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Operations Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest du die operative Steuerung unserer Projekte von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum Projektabschluss. Du bringst unsere Kund:innen strukturiert, effizient und profitabel durch die gesamte Projektphase und stellst sicher, dass alle internen Teams entlang des Prozesses synchron arbeiten. Du arbeitest KPI-getrieben, greifst proaktiv ein und lässt kein Projekt liegen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst Projekte aktiv von Unterschrift bis Abschluss mit dem Ziel, die Cycle Time konsequent zu reduzieren

  • Du greifst proaktiv ein, sobald Zeit-KPIs überschritten werden oder Risiken für Durchlaufzeit, Profitabilität oder Kundenzufriedenheit entstehen

  • Du gewährleistest, dass Projekte vollständig, baubar und jederzeit korrekt im System abgebildet sind und kein Projekt verloren geht

  • Du behältst die Vollständigkeit der Projektunterlagen im Blick – erkennst frühzeitig, was fehlt, und sorgst dafür, dass es rechtzeitig vorliegt

  • Du hast die Profitabilität pro Projekt im Griff: Engpässe und Wartezeiten identifizierst du rechtzeitig, bevor sie auf das Ergebnis drücken

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Support Team zusammen und übernimmst die proaktive, projektspezifische Kommunikation zu definierten Kontaktpunkten

  • Du schaffst transparente und aktuelle Projektstatus und gibst jederzeit Klarheit über Blocker und Handlungsbedarf

  • Du reduzierst Eskalationen durch klare Priorisierung und strukturiertes Follow-up auf ein Minimum

  • Du sicherst hohe Kundenzufriedenheit als direktes Ergebnis sauberer, verlässlicher Projektarbeit

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Technik, Handwerk, Energie, Wirtschaft) oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung im Projekt- oder Operationsumfeld

  • Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in Operations oder in einem technischen Umfeld (z. B. Bau, Handwerk, Energie)

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (C2)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools

  • Erfahrung im Umfeld Wärmepumpe, Photovoltaik oder erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

Ownership: Wenn ein Projekt ins Stocken gerät, hast du das Problem längst erkannt – und bereits gehandelt. Du treibst Projekte intern konsequent voran, adressierst Abhängigkeiten klar und verbindlich gegenüber anderen Teams, und bleibst so lange dran bis das Ergebnis steht.

Expert Operator: Du hast 15 Projekte pro Woche gleichzeitig im Blick – und weißt bei jedem, wo es steht, was als nächstes passieren muss und wo Gefahr droht. Prozesse und Prioritäten sind deine Werkzeuge, um auch bei hohem Volumen handlungsfähig zu bleiben.

Data-Driven Optimizer: Cycle Time, Profitabilität, Terminierungen & Projektfortschritt – du schaust täglich auf deine KPIs, erkennst Muster bevor sie zum Problem werden und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um deinen Prozess kontinuierlich zu schärfen.

Commercially Minded: Du weißt, dass Verzögerungen nicht nur Kunden frustrieren – sie fressen direkt in die Profitabilität. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Wartezeiten oder Eskalationen auf das Ergebnis drücken, und steuerst aktiv dagegen.

Proactive Problem Solver: Fehlende Unterlagen, blockierter Installationstermin, unerreichbarer Kunde – du lässt dich davon nicht aufhalten. Du findest einen Weg und sorgst dafür, dass das Projekt weiterläuft.

Benefits

  • Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups

  • Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

  • Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit anteiligem Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung

  • Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget

  • Clear Communicator: Technische Einschätzungen werden verständlich kommuniziert – gegenüber Montageteams, Vertrieb und Customer Success gleichermaßen.

title: Creative (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Zeal Network
description_html:
ZEAL Network SE ist eine dynamische, international tätige Unternehmensgruppe, die seit über 20 Jahren spannende und innovative Lotterieerlebnisse schafft. Als Deutschlands größter Anbieter von Online-Lotterien mit unseren Marken LOTTO24 und Tipp24 und als zuverlässiger Partner von ONCE, der zweitgrößten nationalen Lotterie Spaniens, gestalten wir die Zukunft der Lotteriebranche. Unsere Leidenschaft für Innovation zeigen wir unter anderem mit unseren neuesten Marken Freiheit+ und Traumhausverlosung, die frische und aufregende Träume Wirklichkeit werden lassen. Darüber hinaus investieren wir über ZEAL Ventures in inspirierende E-Commerce-Start-ups wie Omaze und DAYMADE und fördern damit neue Ideen und Chancen.

Unser Team aus über 350 Expert*innen mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen ist durch eine visionäre Denkweise, eine Leidenschaft für Zusammenarbeit und das gemeinsame Ziel vereint, Träume zu inspirieren. Bei ZEAL ermutigen wir unsere Mitarbeitenden, groß zu denken und gemeinsam an einem gemeinsamen Zweck zu arbeiten: Menschen zu helfen, ihre Träume zu erkennen und zu verwirklichen.

In dieser Rolle entwickelst und produzierst du Werbemittel für alle Marken unter dem Dach von ZEAL: Lotto24, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung und Freiheit+. Du arbeitest interdisziplinär und hands-on, von der ersten Idee über den effizienten Einsatz geeigneter Creative-Tools bis zum finalen Asset, egal ob Static-Asset oder Bewegtbild-Format. Wenn du ein gutes Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und aktuelle Trends mitbringst und gerne mit unterschiedlichen Formaten arbeitest, findest du hier viel Raum für deine Kreativität.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Erstellst hochwertige, markenkonforme Werbemittel für das Performance Marketing aller ZEAL-Marken, also für Lotto24, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung und Freiheit+, von Static-Assets bis zu Motion-Formaten.

  • Arbeitest interdisziplinär und hands-on: von der ersten Idee über den effizienten Einsatz geeigneter Creative-Tools, von Photoshop bis generativer KI, bis zum finalen Asset

  • Bringst ein gutes Gespür für Social Media und Werbung mit, insbesondere für Scroll-stopping Content, kurzweilige Storytelling-Ansätze und relevante Trends

  • Übersetzt Ideen in überzeugende Konzepte und präsentierst, begründest und vertrittst diese gegenüber Stakeholdern

 

Was du mitbringst:

  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Creative-Tools wie Photoshop, InDesign, Premiere und generativer KI

  • Starkes Verständnis für Brand Design und konsistente Markenkommunikation

  • Hohes Maß an Qualitätsbewusstsein, Konsistenz und visueller Präzision

  • Verständnis für Performance-Marketing-Logik (z. B. Hook-Rate, CTR, A/B-Testing von Creatives)

  • Ausgeprägtes Priorisierungsvermögen im Umgang mit mehreren Stakeholdern und Deadlines

  • Wünschenswert:

    • Grundkenntnisse in Kameraarbeit und Videoproduktion, z. B. eigenständiges Drehen und Schneiden von Bewegtbild-Content

    • Erfahrung mit der Skalierung von Content-Produktion im Team- oder Agentur-Kontext

    • Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools in Creative-Workflows

 

Was wir anbieten:

  • Eine moderne, dynamische Unternehmenskultur, basierend auf dem Erfolg eines innovativen E-Commerce-Unternehmens.

  • Ein talentiertes Team aus ambitionierten, gleichgesinnten Kolleg*innen, in dem dein Wissen und deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen.

  • Kontinuierliche persönliche Weiterentwicklung, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 €, das du in deine berufliche Entwicklung investieren kannst.

  • Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung – kein Mikromanagement, sondern echtes Vertrauen in deine Fähigkeiten, hervorragende Ergebnisse zu liefern.

  • Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten mit einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell, das auf Resultate fokussiert ist.

  • Unbegrenzte Urlaubstage zusätzlich zu deinem regulären Urlaubsanspruch von 30 Tagen pro Jahr.

  • Möglichkeit zu Workations im Ausland über unser WorkFlex-Tool.

  • Monatlicher Mobilitätszuschuss von 30 €, den du für das Verkehrsmittel deiner Wahl nutzen kannst (z. B. das Deutschlandticket), sowie Zugang zu einem Fahrrad-Leasing-Programm.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge in Zusammenarbeit mit Degura zur Absicherung deiner finanziellen Zukunft.

  • Geförderte EGYM WELLPASS-Mitgliedschaft – du zahlst nur 25 € pro Monat und erhältst Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitnessstudios und Sportangeboten in ganz Deutschland.

  • Monatliche Firmenevents sowie regelmäßige Teamaktivitäten und informelle Treffen – besonders beliebt: unsere kostenlose Lunches von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro!

 

Klingt interessant? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Robot Learning Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rohlik
description_html:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim..

  • Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like.

Are we a good fit?

Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit?.

What we offer

  • The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one

  • A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets

  • Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started

  • Benefits — see what we offer

Are you in?

Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove.

#LI-ML1 #Knuspr

  • The opportunity to shape the future of online grocery retail across multiple countries

  • Significant influence over company strategy, operational transformation and international growth

  • The chance to build scalable operations with a tangible impact on millions of customers every day

title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Rohlik
description_html:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. other languages will be an advantage.

  • Regular travel to Prague HQ required (min. 4 days per month)

What we offer

  • Unlimited vacation days to support a healthy work-life balance

  • Monthly vouchers: €45 tax-free via become.1

  • €20 monthly internet allowance

  • Knuspr Xtra account and 10% discount in the form of Knuspr credits / cashback

  • Great discounts through Corporate Benefits – fitness, travel, tickets, shopping and much more

  • Real growth: we’re not a traditional corporate.

  • Knuspr vibe: an international team, flat hierarchy, and a first-name culture where mistakes are seen as opportunities to learn

title: Data & Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Statista
description_html:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your role

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer

  • Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes

  • Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consumers via our Kafka-based distribution platform and schema registry

  • Build access-layer data models in our analytics environment (e.g., Snowflake) so applications can work with the data directly, including via API

  • Act as the coordination interface between the Data and Tech divisions, aligning priorities, schemas, and timelines across upstream and downstream teams

Your profile

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role.

  • Strong SQL skills and solid experience in data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas).

  • Hands-on experience with event streaming and message distribution, ideally Kafka, including schema management with the Kafka schema registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema).

  • Experience designing data contracts and schemas between upstream producers and downstream consumers.

  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and modern data stack tools (e.g., dbt, CI/CD).

  • Openness to AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

  • Comfort working at the boundary of streaming/operational data and analytical data models, and building access layers that serve applications via API.

  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused and structured working style.

  • Interest in data governance, standards, and scalable data architecture.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), with both technical and business stakeholders, combined with a solid understanding of business requirements and contexts.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Consultant - Healthcare Data (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Statista
description_html:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare
Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital ratings are published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role
As Data Science Consultant Statista Healthcare, you will join our international team of data professionals, supporting the analytical backbone of Statista’s healthcare activities.

Your work will focus on the collection, processing, and analysis of healthcare data that power our Rankings, Ratings, and Benchmarking projects, as well as the development of new, data-driven products.

In Benchmarking and custom quality development projects with healthcare providers and other stakeholders you will be part of an interdisciplinary project team that works directly with our clients.

You will work hands-on with large and diverse datasets, transform raw data into clean, structured information, and contribute to the automation of our analytical workflows.

In close collaboration with internal analysts, engineers, and project managers, you will ensure that our healthcare data infrastructure remains reliable, scalable, and ready for future integration into the Statista Healthcare Data Platform.

Your work will directly support Statista’s mission to make healthcare quality measurable, comparable, and actionable - globally.

Responsibilities

  • Support in maintaining and further developing Statista’s ranking and rating databases, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and scalability

  • Collaborate on data pilots and benchmarking projects — from design and metric development to scoring and results analysis, interacting directly with our clients as part of an interdisciplinary Statista project team

  • Integrate, clean, and standardize external datasets from hospitals, ministries, and partners for unified use in Statista’s healthcare products

  • Develop and document data models and scoring frameworks in alignment with the Healthcare Analysis and IT teams

  • Support the development of Statista’s Unified Health Database and future Healthcare Data Platform

  • Perform internal analyses and reporting to improve data quality and performance metrics of existing healthcare products

  • Ensure data validation and reproducibility, including peer review and internal QA checks.

  • Actively contribute ideas for new data-driven healthcare products and improvement of existing workflows

Your profile

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Public Health, or related field

  • 4+ years of experience in data analytics, modeling, or applied statistics within Healthcare, Pharma or Life sciences in a client-facing role

  • Proven skills in Python and SQL, proven experience with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar), including dashboard design and storytelling with data

  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to transform complex data into actionable insights

  • Basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts is advantageous

  • Fluent in English, German a plus

  • Highly structured, curious, and motivated to work in an international and cross-functional environment

description_html:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende rund um administrative People-Fragen, in einem abgesteckten Bereich

  • Erstellung von Arbeitszeugnissen

  • Pflege von Stammdaten in Personio z.B. Vertragsanpassungen, Elternzeitanträge, Sabbaticals, Kündigungen, Anlage von Neustartern

  • Freigabe und Verwaltung spezieller Urlaubs- und Änderungsanfragen

  • Verwaltung des Arbeitsunfähigkeitsprozesses und Kommunikation mit Mitarbeitenden rund um Arbeitsunfähigkeitsbescheinigungen

  • Unterstützung der People Operations Manager bei allen Themen rund um den Employee Lifecycle – vom Onboarding bis zum Offboarding

  • Betreuung und Administration von Officevibe

  • Unterstützung der internen Kommunikation z. B. bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von internen Ankündigungen

Dein Profil

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein Auge fürs Detail

  • Klare, empathische Kommunikation und hohe Serviceorientierung gegenüber Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften

  • Proaktives Mindset und ein Fokus auf Teamwork

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch

  • Spaß und Interesse an HR-Themen

Dein Team

People Operations ist das Rückgrat unseres People Teams. Unser Team kümmert sich um die täglichen administrativen Aufgaben, wie die Erstellung und Verwaltung von Arbeitsverträgen, die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und die Koordination aller Statista Standorte auf operativer Ebene. Sie sorgen somit dafür, dass alle operativen HR-Prozesse reibungslos ablaufen.

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

  • Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Internationales Team und regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Karriere- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Attraktive Standorte und moderne Büros

  • Unterstützung für mentale Gesundheit durch OpenUp

About Plaud Inc.

Plaud is building the real-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 2,500,000 users worldwide since 2023. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity.

 

Plaud Inc. is a Delaware-incorporated, San Francisco-based company pushing the boundary of human–AI intelligence through a hardware–software combination. With full ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, GDPR, EN18031, and HIPAA compliances, Plaud is committed to the highest standards of data security and privacy protection. To learn more about Plaud, please visit https://www.plaud.ai and follow along on Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Why You Should Join Us

Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think.

  • Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years.

  • Define the next-gen paradigm for human-AI interaction.

  • Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion.

  • Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success.

  • Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development.

  • Market-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity-fueled work atmosphere.

     

What you will do

  • Own and drive sales growth across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, and Switzerland) and Nordics, achieving revenue, sell-in, and sell-out targets across retail and distribution channels.

  • Build and manage strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and key channel partners, driving joint business planning, forecasting, promotional calendars, inventory health, merchandising, and execution excellence.

  • Lead the regional execution of new product launches, pricing strategies, retail activations, and marketing campaigns, ensuring consistent brand presentation and maximizing commercial impact.

  • Monitor business performance through sales data, outlets, inventory levels, and market trends, providing actionable insights and recommendations to accelerate growth.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Supply Chain, Product, Operations, Customer Success, and HQ to ensure successful execution of regional initiatives.

  • Identify new channel opportunities and strategic partnerships to expand Plaud's market presence.

  • 3-5 years of experience in channel sales, key account management, retail sales, or business development, preferably within consumer electronics, AI products, smart devices, premium consumer technology, or fast-growing hardware brands.

  • Native-level German and fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

  • Proven experience managing distributors, retailers, or key accounts, with strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.

  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with the ability to interpret sell-in, sell-out, inventory, pricing, and channel performance to make informed business decisions.

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and hands-on, with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global cross-functional teams.

title: Internship - Founders' Office
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Telli
description_html:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission

As the Founders' Office Intern at telli, you'll work right alongside the founding team across finance, legal, ops, and special projects. You'll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company operates and a very hands-on role in keeping things running and moving fast.

what you’ll do:

  • help us build the operational backbone behind telli's growth

  • take on special projects, driving initiatives forward by coordinating stakeholders and keeping everything on track

  • support with finance operations by maintaining reports, chasing invoices, and managing payment flow

  • help the growth team close new customers by managing legal and compliance processes

  • support with our hiring pipeline, from screening candidates to scheduling interviews

  • help plan and execute internal and external events and keep the office running smoothly

  • work closely with Ennie and Philipp

what makes you a great fit:

  • you are hands-on and not afraid of doing unglamorous work

  • you're tech- & automation savvy and can learn new tools fast

  • you love solving problems and figuring things out on your own

  • you’re a strong communicator in both English and German

  • you’ve have initial (internship) experience and/or worked on side hustles or projects

  • you're done or at the end of university and could imagine starting full-time after the internship

you may not make a good fit if:

  • you have never touched automation/AI tools or don’t have basic technical understanding

  • you only want to do high-level “strategic” work

  • you aren’t comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once

  • you don’t enjoy working directly with customers or in dynamic environments

  • you’re only looking for a typical 9–5 internship

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

  • • €3K – €5K per month

description_html:
Senior Partnermanager Broker - Channel Cybersecurity (m/w/d)

In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Entwicklung und die Betreuung unseres Maklernetzwerks in Deutschland. Du arbeitest eng mit führenden Versicherungsmakler:innen zusammen und unterstützt sie dabei, Cyber-Versicherung und Cybersicherheit erfolgreich bei ihren Kunden zu platzieren.

Als zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Maklerpartner baust du langfristige Beziehungen auf, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Partner ihr Geschäft mit Eye Security nachhaltig ausbauen können. Dabei verbindest du Versicherungs-Know-how mit einem der relevantesten Zukunftsthemen unserer Zeit: Cybersecurity.

Deine Aufgaben

· Du betreust und entwickelst ein bestehendes Netzwerk von Versicherungsmakler:innen und baust neue strategische Maklerpartnerschaften auf.

· Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Makler Partner in allen vertrieblichen und fachlichen Fragen rund um unsere Cyber-Versicherungslösung.

· Du unterstützt Makler:innen aktiv bei der Identifikation, Ansprache und Beratung potenzieller Kunden und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Vertriebsprozess.

· Du führst regelmäßige Partnertermine durch, erkennst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und entwickelst gemeinsame Vertriebsstrategien zur Steigerung des Geschäftsvolumens.

· Du organisierst und moderierst Schulungen, Workshops und Webinare, damit unsere Partner unsere Lösungen sicher und erfolgreich vermitteln können.

· Du analysierst Vertriebskennzahlen, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale innerhalb deines Partnerportfolios und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

· Du arbeitest eng mit Underwriting, Sales, Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um die bestmögliche Erfahrung für Makler und Kunden sicherzustellen.

· Du vertrittst Eye Security auf Maklerveranstaltungen, Branchenevents und Messen und baust dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich aus.

· Du beobachtest Markttrends und Entwicklungen im Versicherungs- und Cybersecurity-Umfeld und bringst deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Partnerstrategie ein.

Das bringst du mit

· Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Entwicklung von Versicherungsmakler:innen, Versicherungsvertrieben oder relevanten Vertriebspartnern, als Maklerbetreuer bei einem Versicherer oder auch als Accountmanager bei einem Makler

· Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im deutschen Versicherungsmarkt ist von Vorteil.

· Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Versicherungsprodukte, idealerweise aus den Bereichen Insurtech, Fintech, Legaltech oder Compliance.

· Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung von Partnern, Maklerbeziehungen oder Vertriebsportfolios.

· Hohe Eigeninitiative, unternehmerisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität.

· Erfahrung mit vertrieblichen KPIs und einem datengetriebenen Ansatz zur Geschäftsentwicklung.

· Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C2) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

title: Account Executive Germany (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Eye Security
description_html:
About Eye

Eye Security is one of Europe’s fastest-growing cybersecurity and embedded cyber insurance scale-ups - and we want you to be part of it!

We’ve already grown to over 180 employees and continue to expand internationally. Beyond our expanding footprint, we are focused on setting a new standard for what this industry can be. By combining cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time, we bring state-of-the-art protection to the European mid-market.

Our team unites professionals from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds - all driven by one mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players. Are you ready to apply your expertise to a challenge that actually makes a difference? We would like to hear from you!

Your Role at Eye

  • You will strategically work with our market in Germany.

  • You will own and manage full sales cycle from discovery to closing.

  • You will work directly with selling to our end customers as well as act as the primary point of contact for assigned partners (broker and MSP), ensuring strong engagement, enablement, and deal progression.

  • You will build and maintain pipeline creation processes, actively shaping our go-to-market strategy for Germany.

  • You will apply solution selling principles: identify customer pain points, sell the value of minimizing risk, and articulate why Eye’s solutions are worth the investment.

  • You will recognize opportunities for market growth within your assigned region and partner ecosystem.

  • You will serve as a primary link across the organization, facilitating collaboration between customers, partners, and internal departments to drive unified, high-impact results.

  • You will collaborate with Product and Marketing teams and represent Eye at industry events.

Who You Are

  • You have proven experience closing SaaS or software deals, with strong customer-centric discovery and solution-selling skills, ideally with focus on cyber security

  • You have experience selling complex IT infrastructure solutions or managed services, where the value proposition goes beyond cost efficiency and focuses on risk reduction, continuity, and business impact.

  • You demonstrate strong relationship and/or partner management skills.

  • You possess affinity with structured sales methodologies (e.g. MEDDPICC or similar).

  • You are entrepreneurial, driven, and proactive with a strong sense of ownership.

  • You are fluent in German (spoken and written) and speak and understand English very well

  • You should be willing to travel up to 40%

What we offer

  • You will become part of one of the fastest growing cybersecurity scale-ups in Europe.

  • You will play a key role in building an innovative cybersecurity product line where we combine effective cybersecurity with cyber insurance on a global scale.

  • You will evolve alongside the industry - as a rapidly growing scale-up, we provide an environment where your professional development is driven by the dynamic nature of our work and the complexity of the problems we solve.

  • You will enjoy a flexible work setup that supports our distributed team across Germany.

  • An attractive remuneration package and bonus.

  • Car allowance and “floating holidays” for additional time off.

  • MacBook or Windows Laptop and iPhone or Samsung company phone.

  • Strong support for your personal and professional development.

  • Regular company-wide get-togethers, giving you the opportunity to collaborate in person and build strong team connections.
