title: Enterprise Technical Account Executive - m/f/d - UK
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Langdock
description_html:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

You will take Langdock from first conversation to signed contract. Our customers are IT leaders, security teams, and C-Level executives at mid to large companies worldwide. This role is pivotal in driving our expansion across diverse customer segments, from innovative scale-ups and SMBs to established Global Fortune 500 clients.

You'll operate as a trusted technology and AI advisor, combining full ownership of the sales cycle with the technical depth to build real credibility with today's technical buyers - the IT leads, architects, and engineers who now sit at the table alongside business executives in every AI decision. The product sells well, but enterprise deals require someone who can navigate architectural complexity, build trust with both business and technical stakeholders, and close.

What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Sales Mastery: Own the entire sales lifecycle from lead qualification to closing, running technical discovery, solution scoping, and executive presentations that tie Langdock's platform to measurable business outcomes - with a seamless handover to customer success.

  • Technical Credibility: Lead early-stage conversations on APIs, integrations, and system architecture directly with IT and engineering stakeholders, translating what Langdock can do at the platform level into business value for economic buyers - without leaning on a Solutions Engineer to carry the technical thread.

  • Customer Success Advocacy: Build a deep understanding of customers' business models, decision-making processes, and technology landscapes, and continuously analyze customer needs to enhance their success with our solutions.

  • Strategic Revenue Development: Collaborate with partnerships, marketing, and customer success to design effective go-to-market strategies, test new markets and customer segments, and explore new revenue sources for future growth.

  • Market Insight: Deep understanding of our Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and the ability to align solutions with their needs - and provide customer feedback to Product and Leadership to influence the roadmap.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You are proficient in AI technologies, with a preference for those who have previously sold AI solutions. In the best case, you have worked as a Sales Engineer or in similar positions.

  • You have experience selling technical solutions to medium and large companies, with the ability to translate complex platform concepts into business value for non-technical executives. You're comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles by developing and executing account strategies that carry significant quota.

  • You know how to build deep, strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, while staying credible with the technical evaluators in the room.

  • You're curious and customer-centric, with a talent for understanding customers' challenges and coordinating solution design tailored to their needs.

  • You're comfortable operating in a high-growth environment.

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Compensation: €77K – €90K • Offers Equity • €50K – €60K Bonus

About the Role

We’re hiring a hands-on Security Lead to strengthen the security of Langdock’s product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

Your primary focus will be application and infrastructure security. You’ll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to identify risks, assess our defenses, and drive practical improvements. You’ll coordinate penetration tests, triage incoming vulnerability reports, and make sure findings turn into lasting fixes. You should be comfortable getting into technical details, challenging assumptions, and helping engineers choose the right controls.

You’ll also own the security of our internal IT environment, including identity, access, and device security. We’re looking for someone who builds reliable, automated processes and can judge whether our protections are effective.

Alongside this technical work, you’ll help explain our security posture to customers and support our compliance efforts. The foundation of this role is making Langdock secure; audits and customer assessments should reflect that work.

What You Will Do

The role's responsibility will span over multiple fields, which are:

Application security

  • Coordinate penetration tests end to end. Define scope with engineering and external testing partners, support testing, assess findings, and follow remediation through to verification.

  • Own vulnerability intake and triage. Monitor our security inbox and responsible disclosure program, assess reported issues, and work with engineering to prioritize and resolve them.

  • Help engineering build securely. Review security-sensitive designs and changes, identify weaknesses in areas such as authentication, authorization, and data isolation, and recommend practical improvements.

Infrastructure security

  • Assess and improve our security posture. Work with engineering to evaluate how our production infrastructure and internal systems are protected, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

  • Strengthen network and access controls. Review network separation, service exposure, privileged access, and permissions so systems and data are accessible only where needed.

  • Verify that controls work in practice. Look beyond configuration checklists to understand how systems could be compromised and whether our protections would prevent or detect it.

Internal security and automation

  • Own identity and device security. Ensure we have effective MFA, appropriate access policies, and properly managed, encrypted, and patched devices.

  • Automate the employee lifecycle. Build dependable processes for account provisioning, access changes, offboarding, and access reviews across Entra ID and our internal tools.

  • Keep recurring work manageable. Use scripts, integrations, and AI tooling to automate security operations and surface issues that need attention.

Customer assurance and compliance

  • Support customer security assessments. Help answer questionnaires and join customer conversations that require a clear, technically credible explanation of our security controls.

  • Contribute to our compliance programs. Support our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II work through effective controls, current evidence, and technical input into audits and risk assessments.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • Hands-on application and infrastructure security experience. You understand how modern SaaS applications and cloud environments are built, where they can fail, and how to protect them.

  • Technical depth and sound judgment. You can investigate a vulnerability, assess its practical impact, discuss remediation with engineers, and distinguish urgent risks from lower-priority findings.

  • Experience taking findings through to resolution. You’ve worked with penetration testers or vulnerability disclosure programs and helped teams turn reports into verified fixes.

  • Confidence with identity and endpoint security. You’re comfortable configuring identity providers, MFA, access policies, and device management, and automating the processes around them.

  • An automation mindset. You build scripts, workflows, and integrations to reduce recurring work, and use AI tooling thoughtfully to increase your effectiveness.

  • Clear communication. You can explain technical risks and controls to engineers, colleagues, and customers. German is a plus, but not a requirement.

  • Pragmatism. You prioritize meaningful risk reduction and choose controls that teams can realistically implement and maintain.

title: Senior Agronomist - Digital Agronomist Products (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Klim
description_html:
At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams.


We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet!

Your mission:

You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform.

You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendation and assessment engines.

  • Translate agronomic principles into digital products and clear product and engineering specifications.

  • Own and evolve digital agronomy products, including digital decision-support and assessment tools for farmers

  • Expand Klim’s capabilities for regenerative practices in temperate arable systems, including method prioritization, trade-off assessment, and scientific evidence integration.

  • Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products.

  • Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance.

  • Validate agronomic models, algorithms, and prototypes by challenging assumptions, stress-testing outputs against field reality, and approving agronomic soundness before release.

  • Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks.

  • Monitor competitors and support expansion into new markets, geographies, and climate zones.

  • Serve as the internal expert on regenerative arable farming, supporting Product, Sales, Farmer Success, Marketing, Data, and Remote Sensing teams.

  • Review agronomic content, farmer-facing explanations, and English/German copy for accuracy and credibility.

Depending on your experience, profile, skills and Klim’s team setup, this role may also include an Agronomy Team Lead scope with responsibility for managing the agronomy team.

  • Manage the agronomy team, translating strategic projects into execution

  • Review team outputs and ensure high standards of agronomic quality, scientific robustness and farmer relevance.

Your profile:

Agronomic Experience

  • You have 5+ years of experience in agronomy, regenerative agriculture, farm advisory, agricultural science, or a related field.

  • You have strong practical experience working with arable farms through farm management, agronomic advisory, or farmer-facing research.

  • You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline.

  • You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming in temperate climates, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems.

Skills

  • You can translate agronomic expertise into scalable digital products and critically assess models, algorithms, and recommendations.

  • You exercise strong judgement and can develop solutions in ambiguous or novel situations.

  • You are pragmatic, innovative, and motivated to create scalable value for farmers.

  • You are an effective communicator and collaborator across functions.

  • You have an interest in mentoring or team leadership (a plus, not a requirement).

  • You are comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high-quality standards.

Languages

  • You are fluent in English; German is a strong advantage.

Your benefits:

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

title: Senior Account Executive and Partnership Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Klim
description_html:
At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. As a German AgriTech company, we empower farmers in improving soil health, increasing biodiversity, and capturing carbon, while generating reliable income through our platform.

Backed by €22 million in Series A funding, we are scaling our impact internationally and partnering with clients from the food and non-food industry. Since 2020, we have worked with more than 4,000 farmers across 900,000 hectares, covering more than 5% of Germany’s agricultural land.

If you are motivated by building a more sustainable food system and contributing to measurable climate impact, Klim offers the opportunity to do so at scale.

Your mission

As part of Klim's Business Development Team within the Commercial team, you will scale our reach by building and deepening relationships with marketplaces, intermediaries, brokers, and distribution partners. You will drive revenue by developing the channels through which Klim's carbon credits reach buyers at scale and help bring carbon credits to market. This includes designing partnership structures, onboarding intermediaries, and enabling them to represent and sell Klim's offerings with confidence to buyers. This role is for someone who understands that the most durable commercial impact comes from building the right ecosystems, not just closing individual deals.

If you enjoy working in fast-moving environments, value thoughtful, consultative sales and want your work to contribute to real-world change, we are happy to hear from you.

Your responsibilities

  • Own and grow a high-value partnership pipeline, from first and ongoing conversations to contract signature and sales enablement with a variety of partners ranging from start-ups to established carbon credit marketplaces. We are looking at success measures activation of partners and sourced revenue via partnerships.

  • Research, structure, carry-out and review a partnership strategy to engage qualified and new market segments. Understand and communicate successes, risks, and mitigations transparent to management through optimized reporting and utilization of our CRM.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to understand prospective client needs, decision criteria and internal stakeholder dynamics to present offerings that position Klim as a strategic solution provider for clients’ sustainability, ESG and climate strategies.

  • Identify, evaluate and onboard marketplace partners and distribution channels (e.g. sustainability platforms, brokers, consultancies, ESG solution providers) that can scale Klim's reach into new buyer segments.

  • Lead joint business planning conversations with partners to align on value propositions, go-to-market approaches, integration requirements and shared success metrics.

  • Design and maintain a partner enablement program, providing marketplace partners and intermediaries with the materials, training and tools needed to represent Klim's offerings effectively and compliantly.

  • Collaborate closely with finance, certification, marketing and product to ensure seamless handovers and strong client outcomes.

  • Track and monitor key sales metrics through diligent CRM maintenance, track market trends in an independent way and gather client feedback proactively to optimise individual and team sales performance.

  • Stay on top of developments in carbon markets, standards, and regulation (e.g. SBTi, Verra, CCP, CRCF) to inform conversations and sharpen positioning.

  • Represent Klim at industry events, conferences and sustainability forums to expand your network and generate new leads.

Your profile

  • Business-ready fluency in English is a must. A upper intermediate level of German (B2) is a plus.

  • At least three years of experience in a quota-carrying partnership management or sales role, with full responsibility for closing deals.

  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling partnership channels or marketplace relationships — from identifying and structuring agreements to activating and growing them over time.

  • Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder relationships with partners and intermediaries, paired with strong account management skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • A proven track record of managing the full sales funnel end to end, with confidence in handling six-figure deals and maintaining strong CRM discipline, including accurate opportunity stages and clearly documented next steps.

  • General working knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (preferably MEDDPICC) and the ability to run structured pipeline reviews, clearly articulating blockers, risks and decision paths across multiple active opportunities.

  • Experience drafting, tailoring and optimising presentations and other materials for client-facing and internal use; advanced proficiency with Google Workspace or comparable tools is required.

  • A collaborative, people-oriented mindset: you enjoy working closely with colleagues across teams and contributing to a positive, mission-driven culture.

  • Motivation to contribute to Klim’s mission of accelerating the transition to regenerative agriculture, and a belief that commercial excellence is a key lever for real-world impact.

  • A plus: experience in carbon markets and environmental policy, including voluntary carbon markets, pricing dynamics, and relevant standards and frameworks.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: We offer an attractive base salary plus uncapped commission on partner-sourced revenue. Commission is structured around partner activation and revenue growth, rewarding you for building a channel that performs at scale.

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Additional benefits for full time, Germany based employees: We offer membership in the Urban Sports Club or subsidisation of the Deutschlandticket, contribution to a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

title: C005419 Senior Project Transition Manager (NS) - MON 5 Oct
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Emw
description_html:
Deadline Date: Monday 5 October 2026

Requirement: Senior Project Transition Manager

Location: Wiesbaden, DE

Full Time On-Site: Yes

Time On-Site: 100%

Total Scope of the request (hours): 350

Required Start Date: 10 November 2026

End Contract Date: 23 December 2026

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

 

Duties & Role: 

Project Transition to Operations

  • Leads the transition of projects and capabilities into operational service, from early engagement in project planning through to formal handover and early life support.
  • Defines and agrees transition plans, entry and exit criteria, service acceptance criteria and handover deliverables with Project Managers, Service Owners and customers.
  • Ensures operational readiness prior to go-live: support model, staffing, training, documentation, spares, underpinning contracts, monitoring and configuration data are in place.
  • Evaluates project outputs against agreed service acceptance criteria and formally recommends acceptance, conditional acceptance or rejection.
  • Identifies, manages and escalates transition risks, issues and dependencies, and ensures residual risks are understood and owned by operations.
  • Manages early life support and closes transition only when agreed service performance has been demonstrated.
  • Captures and applies lessons identified to improve future transitions.

Local Operations Management (Wiesbaden)

  • Takes accountability for the day-to-day delivery of NCIA services at the location, including service performance, customer satisfaction and compliance with security and safety requirements.
  • Leads and coordinates local technical, support and contractor personnel, setting clear priorities, standards and direction.
  • Oversees the local infrastructure (facilities, networks, data centre / server rooms, end-user and deployable CIS assets) and ensures it is maintained, secured and fit for purpose.
  • Ensures asset and configuration management records for the location are accurate and complete.
  • Coordinates local business continuity and service recovery arrangements.

Incident and Problem Management

  • Ensures incidents are logged, prioritised, diagnosed and resolved according to agreed procedures and service levels.
  • Leads the resolution of major incidents, coordinating technical teams, vendors and customers, and provides timely, accurate communication to senior stakeholders.
  • Escalates unresolved incidents and facilitates recovery following resolution.
  • Initiates and monitors problem investigations, drives root cause analysis and ensures preventive measures are implemented.
  • Analyses incident and problem trends to reduce recurrence and improve service stability.

Change Management

  • Manages the change control process for services and assets at the location and for services in transition.
  • Assesses changes for risk, impact, cost and resource requirements, and represents the location in Change Advisory Boards.
  • Ensures changes are planned, communicated, tested, implemented and reviewed in a controlled manner, minimizing disruption to operations.

Service Level Management

  • Negotiates service level requirements and agreed service levels with customers, and contributes to Service Level Agreements, Operational Level Agreements and underpinning contracts.
  • Monitors service performance and key performance indicators, diagnoses service delivery problems and initiates improvement actions.
  • Provides accurate and regular performance reporting to NCIA management and customers.
  • Drives continual service improvement across processes, tools and third-party delivery.

Cost, Resource and Vendor Management

  • Manages the operational and transition budget for the location, including cost planning, forecasting, tracking and variance reporting.
  • Provides inputs to customer budget processes, cost models and service rates, ensuring the full cost of operating transitioned services is identified and funded.
  • Identifies cost optimisation opportunities without compromising service levels or security.
  • Manages vendor and contractor performance against contractual obligations, statements of work and service levels, and supports procurement activities as required.

 

Specific Working Conditions: Occasional travel within NATO nations, including to operational sites, may be required.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • A minimum requirement of a Bachelor's degree at a nationally recognised/certified university in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline, and 8 years' post-related experience.
  • Or exceptionally, the lack of a university degree may be compensated by the demonstration of a candidate's particular abilities or experience that is/are of interest to the NCI Agency, that is, at least 12 years' extensive and progressive expertise in duties related to the function of the post.
  • Minimum 8 years of combined experience in IT service management and project management, of which at least 3 years in a senior role.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in IT service management in a Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager or similar role, including incident, problem, change and service level management.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in project management, delivering complex IT/CIS projects to time, cost and quality.
  • Demonstrable track record of transitioning projects or new capabilities into live operational service.
  • Proven experience engaging, influencing and briefing senior stakeholders at executive (C-level) or General/Flag Officer level.
  • Experience managing IT infrastructure (networks, data centres, servers, end-user and communications systems) in an operational environment.
  • Experience in budget and cost management, including forecasting, cost control and financial reporting.
  • Proven experience managing vendors and contractors against contractual and service level obligations.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams in an international environment.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions under pressure.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation (or ITIL v3 Foundation).
  • Project management certification: PMP (PMI / PMBOK) or PRINCE2 Practitioner.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in NATO, military, defence or other international organisations.
  • Experience with deployable CIS or mission-critical communications services.
  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader; MSP or PgMP; SIAM certification.
  • Experience with ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management).
  • Knowledge of NATO procurement and financial processes.
  • Working knowledge of German.

title: Solution Architect – Client Solutions (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fincite Gmbh
description_html:
Deine Herausforderungen

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unseren Entwicklungsteams und verbringst einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit im direkten Austausch mit Kunden.
  • Du hörst genau hin, verstehst die Kundenprobleme und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Fragestellungen, die unsere Entwickler konkret bearbeiten können.
  • Auf Basis deines tiefen technischen Hintergrunds entwickelst du Lösungsarchitekturen, die sowohl zu den Anforderungen des Kunden als auch zu unserer eigenen Systemlandschaft passen.
  • Dabei denkst du in Systemen: Du verstehst unsere Architektur, die technische Umgebung unserer Kunden, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten und kannst diese Welten sinnvoll zusammenbringen.
  • Bei APIs und Integrationen kannst du nicht nur Anforderungen formulieren, sondern auch auf technischer Ebene mit unseren Entwicklern über Lösungswege und deren Auswirkungen diskutieren.
  • Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten technischen Idee auch eine funktionierende Lösung wird.
  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Engineering sorgst du für Klarheit: Was ist das eigentliche Problem? Was brauchen wir technisch? Was ist sinnvoll umsetzbar?
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen, koordinierst unterschiedliche Stakeholder und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick.


Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Product Management, Softwareentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Business und Technologie.
  • Ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und API-Design. Ein Entwicklerhintergrund ist dabei ein klarer Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, Kundenprobleme und fachliche Anforderungen wirklich zu verstehen und in klare, umsetzbare technische Anforderungen zu übersetzen.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du kannst technische Themen auf Augenhöhe diskutieren, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln und gemeinsam mit Entwicklern pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Interesse an Wealth Management, Finanztechnologie und SaaS sowie die Bereitschaft, dich tief in fachliche und technische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten.
  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen und Lösungen strukturiert bis in die Umsetzung zu begleiten.


Unser Angebot

Wir sind ein etabliertes Produktunternehmen mit dem Spirit eines Startups. Dich erwarten Teamgeist, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Freiheit, dein Arbeitsumfeld zu gestalten. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Weiterbildungsbudgets und attraktive Benefits geben dir Raum für persönliche Entwicklung, Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein erfülltes Leben.


Sprachkenntnisse

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau 
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Ansprechpartner/in

Julian Eder

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Buchhaltung und Fuhrparkmanagement
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at teamZUKUNFT gGmbH
description_html:
teamHOLDING GmbH

Wir, die teamHOLDING Gmbh stehen für Vielfalt mit Haltung – und für Angebote, die Menschen in ihrer Entwicklung stärken. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt im pädagogischen Bereich, ergänzt durch erlebnispädagogische Programme und unterstützende Dienstleistungen.  

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine motivierte und zuverlässige Person im Bereich Fuhrparkmanagement und Verwaltung.  


Daily Business

  • Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Verwaltung unseres Fuhrparks
  • Planung, Koordination und Überwachung von Inspektionen, Wartungen, Reparaturen und gesetzlichen Prüfungen (z. B. TÜV, AU)
  • Koordination und Wahrnehmung von Terminen rund um unsere Fahrzeuge
  • Verwaltung und Bearbeitung von Schadensfällen und Unfällen
  • Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Werkstätten, Leasinggesellschaften, Versicherungen und weiteren Dienstleistern
  • Überwachung von Fristen sowie Dokumentation relevanter Fahrzeugunterlagen
  • Unterstützung bei Fahrzeugübernahmen und -rückgaben
  • Kontrolle und Verwaltung von Betriebskosten, beispielsweise für Kraftstoff, Wartung und Leasing
  • Unterstützung bei allgemeinen organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben
  • Unterstützung in der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung, sowie der Monatssteuer
  • Erfassung und Prüfung von Geschäftsvorgängen
  • Mithilfe bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen


Deine Skills

  • Laufendes Studium, beispielsweise im Bereich Wirtschaft, Verwaltung, Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Motivation und Zuverlässigkeit
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office
  • Führerschein Klasse B


Deine Benefits

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabenfeld mit viel Eigenverantwortung
  • Ein engagiertes, aufgeschlossenes und kreatives Team
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
Wer wir sind? 

Zur teamHOLDING GmbH gehören unter anderem: teamZUKUNFT gGmbH – freier Träger der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe sowie Programmanbieter für Klassenfahrten und Feriencamps, teamEXPERTE GmbH – erlebnispädagogische Outdoor- und Teamtrainings sowie Aus- und Weiterbildung, teamJUGENDHERBERGEN GmbH – eigene Programmhäuser wie die Jugendherberge Hilchenbach sowie teamSERVICE GmbH – Hausmeister- und Facility-Services. 

Was uns verbindet: Wir schaffen Räume, in denen Menschen wachsen – mit Herz, Haltung und einem starken Team. 

Bewirb dich jetzt!

title: Maintainer (m/dw/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Velptec
description_html:
Über uns

Richte dich neu aus. Auf deine Zukunft. Mit velpTEC.

velpTEC ist ein auf innovative Technologien ausgerichtetes Weiterbildungsinstitut, das Erfahrungen aus Wirtschaft, Zukunftsforschung und neuen Bildungsansätzen verbindet. Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. In unserem Handeln legen wir Wert auf gesellschaftliche Verantwortung, Fortschritt und Selbstbestimmung. 

Bereit für eine neue Mission? Dann entdecke jetzt deine Zukunftsperspektive bei velpTEC und werde Teil unseres multiprofessionellen und diversen Teams. 

Wir bauen unsere digitalen Produkte in einem neuen, KI-nativen Produktteam mit fünf klaren Rollen: Prototyper, Builder, Sweeper, Grower und Maintainer. Jede Rolle hat einen eigenen Auftrag im Lebenszyklus eines Produkts, von der ersten Idee bis zum verlässlichen Betrieb. Gearbeitet wird an unserem Online-Campus, unseren Websites, unserem Shop und an neuen KI-gestützten Lern- und Vertriebsprodukten. 

Du möchtest dafür sorgen, dass ein Produkt trägt, sobald Menschen sich darauf verlassen? Als Maintainer (m/w/d) hältst du unsere gereiften Systeme schnell, sicher und verfügbar, während Nutzendenzahlen und Funktionsumfang wachsen. Du automatisierst den Betrieb, machst den Zustand der Systeme jederzeit sichtbar und bringst Störungen strukturiert und ruhig zu Ende. Das Erfahrungslevel halten wir offen: Junior bis Senior ist möglich. Entscheidend ist deine Lust, gemeinsam mit KI-Werkzeugen großartige Ergebnisse zu gestalten.


Was deine Aufgaben sein werden

  • Verfügbarkeit & Performance: Monitoring, Alerting und Zielwerte für Verfügbarkeit und Antwortzeiten aufbauen und einhalten
  • Betrieb automatisieren: Deployments, Updates, Backups und Wiederherstellung über Infrastructure as Code und Pipelines abbilden
  • Störungen beheben: Vorfälle systematisch eingrenzen, beheben, Ursachen dokumentieren und Wiederholungen ausschließen
  • Sicherheit:Patches, Abhängigkeiten, Zugriffsrechte und Datenschutzanforderungen laufend im Blick behalten
  • Kosten & Kapazität: Cloud-Kosten transparent machen und Kapazitäten für Wachstum vorausplanen
  • Campus-Betrieb: Unsere Lernplattform mit dem externen Dienstleister stabil und aktuell halten
  • KI als Werkzeug: Log-Analysen, Runbooksund wiederkehrende Betriebsaufgaben mit KI-Werkzeugen beschleunigen
  • Zusammenarbeit: Übergaben mit Builder und Sweeper gestalten und Betriebswissen im Team verfügbar machen


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem technischen Bereich, zum Beispiel in Informatik, Engineering oder Computer Science
  • Erfahrung im Betrieb von Webanwendungen in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS, GCP oder Azure
  • Kenntnisse in Containern, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code, zum Beispiel Docker, GitHub Actions und Terraform
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Monitoring und Observability, zum Beispiel Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry oder Uptime-Monitoring
  • Linux-Kenntnisse sowie Grundlagen in Netzwerk und Datenbankbetrieb inklusive Backups
  • Scripting- oder Entwicklungskenntnisse, zum Beispiel Python, Bash oderTypeScript
  • Erfahrung mit PHP- undMoodle-Umgebungen ist von Vorteil
  • Freude daran, KI-Werkzeuge für Analyse, Automatisierung und Dokumentation zu nutzen
  • Ruhige, systematische Fehlersuche und Verantwortungsbewusstsein für laufende Systeme
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und gute Englischkenntnisse


Was dich bei velpTEC erwartet

  • Vollständiges Home-Office oder hybrides Arbeiten an unseren Standorten in München, Leipzig oder Hannover
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Kernarbeitszeit – Arzttermine, Kita und andere wichtige Termine sind kein Problem
  • Fixgehalt + Provision + Zielbonus + 100 € (in Vollzeit) monatliche betriebliche Altersvorsorge nach 6 Monaten + 15 % Zuschuss auf Eigenanteil + attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • 3 bezahlte Educational Days pro Jahr für Weiterbildungen + 1 zusätzlicher Urlaubstag für Ehrenamt
  • Einjährliches Gesundheitsbudget von 600 € (in Vollzeit) nach 6 Monaten + Zugang zu über 13.000 Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und gemeinsame Erlebnisse
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und Offenheit für neue Ideen und Innovationen

title: Quereinsteiger E-Commerce (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rügamer & Steiner Consulting GmbH
description_html:
Wir suchen jemanden, der bei uns Newsletter schreibt und sie gleich fertig baut.

Kurz zu uns: Wir sind Rügamer & Steiner aus Düsseldorf, über 35 Leute, und wir machen E-Mail-Marketing für mehr als 150 Online-Shops. In Zahlen: 8 E-Mails pro Sekunde, 250 Millionen Empfänger im Jahr. Jede einzelne Zeile davon hat jemand von uns geschrieben & designt.

Wenn du gerade Texte abgibst und danach nie wieder siehst, was daraus geworden ist: Hier ist es ungefähr das Gegenteil.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben liegen morgens bereit. Ein Shop braucht einen Sale-Newsletter, der nächste stellt eine neue Kategorie vor. Du liest dich ins Briefing ein, überlegst dir den Aufbau, schreibst Betreffzeile und Text, ziehst dir die Blöcke aus unserem Figma-Designsystem und passt die Grafiken an, teilweise mit KI. Dann geht der Newsletter zur Freigabe an den Kunden und raus.

Du betreust 30 bis 40 Marken. Nach ein paar Wochen weißt du, wie jede einzelne klingt.

Qualifikation

  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft: Bei uns wird Vollgas gegeben, 100 % vor Ort mit dem Team in Düsseldorf.
  • Auge für Ästhetik: Du hast ein Auge dafür, was gut aussieht, und traust dich an ein Design-Tool.
  • Extrem schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Neue Tools lernst du in Tagen.
  • Ehrgeiz und Eigenantrieb: Du nimmst Feedback an und wirst mit jeder Woche besser.
  • Du gehst selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools um.
  • Du schreibst gut und schnell. Texte, die verkaufen, nicht Texte, die nur schön klingen.
  • Du willst das ganze Ding verantworten, nicht nur deinen Teil davon.

Figma, Newsletter oder Designausbildung? Kein Muss.

Auge, Tempo und Einstellung entscheiden. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Benefits

  • Kein internes Ping-Pong. Du gibst deinen Text nicht weiter und wartest, was zurückkommt. Du baust den Newsletter selbst zu Ende.
  • Der ganze Newsletter gehört dir: Text, Aufbau, Bildwelt. Du gibst die Richtung vor.
  • Deine Arbeit geht raus. An echte Kunden echter Marken, nicht in eine Ablage. Und du kriegst mit, wie sie gelaufen ist.
  • 30 bis 40 Marken parallel. In einem Jahr machst du hier mehr Kampagnen als woanders in fünf.
  • 3.500 bis 6.000 € im Monat. Ziel jeder Einstellung ist die unbefristete Übernahme.
  • Modernes Büro in Düsseldorf Pempelfort mit Dachterrasse und ÖPNV-Anschluss.
  • Beste Hardware von Apple, höhenverstellbare Tische.
  • Junges Team und Geschäftsführung
  • Pluxee Card
  • Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft
  • Apple-Hardware
  • Aktive Arbeit mit modernster KI
  • Monatliche Teamevents

Rügamer & Steiner ist eine inhabergeführte Agentur für E-Mail- & CRM-Marketing im E-Commerce, gegründet von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner in Düsseldorf. Wir bauen für über 150 Online-Shops im DACH-Raum E-Mail-Marketing, das wirklich Umsatz bringt. Wir messen uns an Ergebnissen, nicht an Stunden und bringen jeden weiter, der bereit ist, dafür zu arbeiten.

Online Marketing Manager · Digital Marketing Manager · Content Creator · Creative Strategist · E-Commerce · Online Shops · Performance Marketing · Digital · AI · Claude · ChatGPT · Figma

IT Security & Compliance Lead – HealthTech (w/m/d)

Berlin Mitte – Hybrid, €70.000 – €100.000 Jahresgehalt, 28 Tage Urlaub

WICHTIG: Wer ausschließlich als Freelancer arbeiten will, ist hier falsch.

Du willst nicht nur Richtlinien schreiben, du willst die komplette Sicherheitsarchitektur in der Cloud bauen und verantworten. Du willst nicht nur Berichte abliefern, du willst Audits von ISO 27001 und BSI‑C5 eigenständig bestehen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Dokumentation, hier geht es um Hands‑On‑Arbeit mit Terraform, AWS und GCP. Hier geht es nicht um einen starren 9‑to‑5‑Job, hier geht es um eine 32‑Stunden‑Option, Equity und direkten Einfluss auf die Gründer.

Unser Kunde

Ein Berliner HealthTech‑Startup mit rund zehn Mitarbeitenden, das KI‑gestützte Software zur Automatisierung psychotherapeutischer Dokumentation entwickelt. Die Plattform entlastet Therapeuten von administrativen Aufgaben und verbessert die Patientenversorgung. Das Unternehmen positioniert sich als innovativer Anbieter im Schnittfeld von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Gesundheits‑ und Software‑Technologie.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

Hohe Verantwortung – End‑to‑End‑Ownership über Security & Compliance.

Technische Hands‑On‑Arbeit – Cloud‑Security und IaC mit Terraform.

Stabiles Vollzeit‑Umfeld mit 32‑Stunden‑Option.

Equity‑Beteiligung über VESOP.

Direkter Einfluss – täglicher Kontakt zu Gründern und CTO.

Aufgaben

  • Own security & compliance end‑to‑end: Cloud, Produkt und interne IT.
  • Harden und betreibe AWS/GCP‑Umgebungen: IAM, Netzwerk, Verschlüsselung, Logging, Monitoring, Detection.
  • Embed DevSecOps in den SDLC: Threat Modeling, Vulnerability Management, Secure Code Reviews.
  • Leite ISO 27001‑ und BSI‑C5‑Zertifizierungen inkl. Audits, Evidenz‑ und Risikomanagement.
  • Koordiniere Pen‑Tests, Security‑Reviews und Vendor Assessments.
  • Definiere und pflege interne IT‑Baselines: Identity, MDM, Device‑Policies, On‑/Off‑boarding.
  • Biete pragmatische Security‑Guidance und push back bei Architektur‑Entscheidungen.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Hands‑On‑Erfahrung in Cloud‑Security (AWS oder GCP) inkl. Terraform.
  • Vollständige Audit‑Ownership von ISO 27001 / BSI‑C5 inklusive erfolgreicher Zertifizierung.
  • Erfahrung mit DevSecOps, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling und Vulnerability Management.
  • Fließende Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C1).
  • Bachelor‑Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.
  • Nachweisbare Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering‑Teams in kleinen, async‑first Umgebungen.

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Freelancer – keine langfristige Anstellung.
  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel (< 2 Jahre) sind ein Dealbreaker.
  • Policy‑Only‑Background – keine technische Hands‑On‑Erfahrung.
  • Fehlende Audit‑Erfahrung (ISO 27001/BSI‑C5) – kein Platz für reine Dokumentationsrollen.
  • Keine Bereitschaft, in Berlin vor Ort zu arbeiten.

Benefits

  • 4,5‑Tag‑Woche bei 28 Tagen Urlaub
  • Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung
  • JobRad‑Leasing
  • EGYM Wellpass
  • Geförderte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Team‑Events und ein inklusives Arbeitsklima
  • Attraktives Gehalt bis zu 100 k €
  • Virtuelle Beteiligung (VESOP)

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Vollständige Ownership über Security & Compliance in einem wachsenden HealthTech‑Startup.
  • Breites Hands‑On‑Spektrum von Cloud‑Hardening bis Audit‑Leitung – steile Lernkurve garantiert.
  • Direkter, täglicher Austausch mit Gründer:innen & CTO ohne Hierarchien.
  • Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als IT Security & Compliance Lead – HealthTech (w/m/d). Egal ob dein Titel Security Lead, Head of Security oder Security & Compliance Manager heißt: Entscheidend ist, dass du mindestens 5 Jahre Hands‑On‑Erfahrung in Cloud‑Security hast und die komplette ISO 27001/BSI‑C5 Zertifizierung eigenverantwortlich leitest.

title: SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at IBS Schreiber GmbH
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Als SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m/w/d) gestaltest du gemeinsam mit uns die sichere SAP-Welt von morgen. Dich erwarten spannende Prüfungs- und Beratungsprojekte rund um moderne SAP-Technologien wie S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, SAP BTP und innovative Security-Lösungen. Wenn du technologische Neugier, Beratungskompetenz und Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mitbringst, bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen, Kunden begeistern und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

Vollzeit (39h/Woche) II Hamburg (Hybrid) oder full-remote
 
Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn Du Spaß hast,...

  • Unsere Kunden in Security- & Berechtigungsfragen innerhalb der SAP-Welt mit Schwerpunkt in den SuccessFactors Modulen, Concur und SAP HCM zu beraten
  • Dich idealerweise mit Security-Tools wie z.B. SAP Access Control, SAP IAG, One Identity Manager, Pathlock SAST, Xiting XAMS etc. zu befassen
  • mit Hilfe von Generativer KI unsere Produkte und deine Arbeitsabläufe zu verbessern
  • in Prüfungsaufträgen und Beratungsprojekten bei unseren Kunden eine leitende Rolle zu übernehmen
  • interne und externe Workshops zu Themen in HR-Prozessen (Security & Berechtigungen) durchzuführen


Dein Profil

  • du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mitbringst
  • mehrjährige Kenntnisse im Bereich Human Ressource Cloud Technologien gesammelt hast und dich gut in den SAP SuccessFactors Module Employee Central, Time Management, Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Performance & Goals, Succession & Development, Compensation, Analytics auskennst
  • dich idealerweise auch gut mit Concur und externer HR-Software auskennst
  • gerne selbstständig, analytisch und konzeptionell
  • du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2) und gute Englischkenntnisse verfügst


Warum wir?

Wir sind für dich der richtige Arbeitgeber, weil:

  • uns ein familiäres Arbeitsklima wichtig ist
  • wir als Pionier im Bereich SAP Security & Berechtigungsanalysen neue Wege gehen
  • du deine Arbeit auch von zu Hause durchführen kannst
  • dir eine flache Hierarchie wichtig ist

title: Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at MAOMAO Technologies
description_html:
MAOMAO is a fast-growing online supermarket for Asian food, combining e-commerce with content, community and social commerce.

We don't just sell products. We introduce people to new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products.

As MAOMAO continues to grow, we're looking for a Marketing Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership and help shape the next stage of our marketing.

Aufgaben

What You'll Do

Campaigns & Product Launches

You will plan and coordinate marketing campaigns, promotions, product launches and livestreams from idea to execution.

This includes:

  • developing campaign and launch plans
  • creating timelines, responsibilities and deadlines
  • coordinating content and communication across our channels
  • making sure everyone involved knows what needs to happen and when
  • keeping projects moving and following up on deliverables
  • identifying problems and dependencies early
  • reviewing results and turning learnings into better future campaigns

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond individual tasks and takes responsibility for making the overall project work.

TikTok Shop & Social Commerce

Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue developing.

You will work on:

  • TikTok Shop campaigns and promotions
  • Seller Center and campaign management
  • livestream campaigns and activations
  • product and promotional planning
  • coordination with TikTok and external partners
  • identifying and testing new opportunities in social commerce

Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter just as much.

Marketing & Content

You will work with our team to develop campaigns and content around Asian food, products, trends and culture.

You will help decide:

  • which products and topics we should focus on
  • how we communicate them to our audience
  • which content formats and channels make sense
  • how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, our online shop, email and other channels

We want someone who doesn't just create marketing, but increasingly understands why something works and how we can make it better.

Team & Project Coordination

Good ideas only matter if they get executed.

You will help coordinate marketing projects across the team, keep track of priorities and deadlines and make sure projects move forward.

Depending on your experience, you may also:

  • coordinate responsibilities within the marketing team
  • improve workflows and processes
  • support and guide other team members
  • take responsibility for larger marketing initiatives
  • help shape marketing priorities together with the founders

There is room to take on more leadership responsibility as both you and MAOMAO grow.

Your Role Can Grow With You

We don't expect one person to be an expert in every area of marketing.

Depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you can gradually take on additional responsibility in areas such as:

Performance & KPIs
Analyzing campaign performance, defining measurable goals and using data to improve marketing decisions.

Marketing Budgets
Managing defined budgets and deciding how resources should be allocated across campaigns and channels.

CRM & Email Marketing
Developing how we communicate with existing customers and improve retention.

What Ownership Means at MAOMAO

Ownership is one of the most important parts of how we work.

It doesn't mean working endless hours or having all the answers.

It means thinking beyond the individual task.

If we are launching a new product in four weeks, we don't want someone who simply waits for a list of things to do.

We want someone who thinks:

What are we trying to achieve? What needs to happen? Which channels should we use? What content do we need? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What are we missing? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked?

Just as importantly, we value people who think in solutions, not only in problems.

Pointing out that something is not working is useful. But we expect you to go one step further:

What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step?

You should be willing to make informed decisions, experiment, learn from results and iterate quickly rather than waiting for a perfect answer.

Not every idea will work. That is okay.

What matters is that we learn fast, adjust fast and keep moving.

The mindset we're looking for is:

“Here is the problem. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next.”

Qualifikation

Who We're Looking For

We're open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience, but we're looking for someone who has already gained meaningful hands-on marketing experience and is ready to take ownership.

You should:

  • have at least 2 years of relevant experience in marketing, e-commerce, social media, content, campaign management or a related field
  • have fluent German skills (C1 or native-level), as you will be developing marketing for a predominantly German-speaking audience
  • have strong working proficiency in English
  • be highly organized, reliable and proactive
  • take initiative and think ahead
  • be able to turn ideas into structured plans and execution
  • communicate clearly and follow through
  • feel comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes
  • think in solutions rather than simply escalating problems
  • be willing to experiment, test and iterate quickly
  • be comfortable making decisions even when not every answer is obvious
  • have a strong interest in e-commerce, social media and social commerce
  • be comfortable working with data, KPIs and budgets
  • enjoy working in a fast-moving environment
  • be hands-on when needed
  • learn quickly and actively look for ways to improve

Experience in e-commerce, TikTok, TikTok Shop, social media, CRM, performance marketing or campaign management is a plus.

Chinese language skills are a plus but they are NOT a requirement.

Benefits

Benefits

What we offer

  • A central marketing role with a high level of ownership and room to shape how we work
  • Direct collaboration with the founders
  • Founders with backgrounds in venture capital and e-commerce
  • An existing marketing and content team to work with
  • Our own office, warehouse and content setup in Berlin
  • Short decision-making paths and the freedom to actually implement ideas
  • Plenty of room to experiment, test new formats and iterate quickly
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, livestreaming and brand building
  • The opportunity to shape campaigns and launches from idea to execution instead of owning only one small part of the process
  • Clear professional and personal development opportunities, including the potential to take on more leadership responsibility
  • A young, international team with a lot of passion and team spirit
  • Employee discount across our assortment

Interested?

Send us your CV and a short introduction telling us why you want to join MAOMAO and what excites you about this role.

We'd also like you to answer one question:

Tell us about a marketing campaign, project or experiment you took ownership of. What was your goal, what did you do, and what was the result?

It doesn't have to be a huge campaign or a perfect success. We're interested in how you think, how you approach problems and what you learn from the things you try.

One last thing: We don't mind if you use AI to help with your application – we use AI too. But if your application could be sent to 50 other companies by simply replacing the company name, it's probably not for us. Show us why MAOMAO, and show us how you think.

If you want to take ownership, move fast and help us grow a category that has been treated as a niche for far too long, we'd love to hear from you.

Maybe you're the Sriracha to our noodle soup. 🌶️🍜

title: Lead Implementation & Delivery (f/m/d)
description_html:
We're looking for an experienced implementation, delivery or technical operations lead to own delivery after a contract is signed — and to play a central role in working out what actually makes our product work for customers.

This one is for you if:

  • You'd rather build the playbook than wait for one to exist
  • You get real satisfaction from being the person people can count on — customers and colleagues alike
  • Making a genuinely complex, technical product work in the real world, on a factory floor and not just a slide deck, sounds like a good problem to have

Every factory should be as easy to redesign as a CAD file. RIIICO scans real production floors and turns the raw point cloud into a structured, living model of the plant — machines, robots and infrastructure recognised by AI, matched to CAD, usable directly in the engineering tools our customers already run. Line changes that used to take months of manual work now take days.

We're seed-funded, backed by Earlybird, PiLabs and seed + speed, with angels including Joe Kaeser, former CEO of Siemens.

Team: two application engineers report to you directly, and you steer our data delivery team, which has its own manager and five people.
Start: as soon as you can.

Tasks

You'll own the entire post-sale delivery, from signed deal to a customer who's live, confident and getting real value. Our customers are enterprise manufacturers, so the accounts you own are complex and technically demanding from day one. As an early hire there's no existing playbook — expect to blend hands-on implementation, delivery operations and testing product-market-fit hypotheses directly with customers.

  • Own the post-sale journey, from handover through to stable, value-delivering adoption
  • Build the adoption framework for enterprise accounts, and define what "first value" means
  • Keep a current view of every account: check-ins, early risk signals, retention plans
  • Handle escalations yourself, at both operational and management level
  • Own the Sales-to-delivery handover and keep capacity visible and realistic
  • Develop the lightweight processes that make delivery repeatable as patterns emerge
  • Lead and develop your team, and shape how Delivery is structured as we grow
  • Test the product-market-fit hypotheses Sales brings back, and feed findings into Product and Go-To-Market

What this looks like in your first six months:

  • Months 1–2 — run two live enterprise implementations yourself, end to end, so you know where the product and the process actually break
  • Months 2–3 — take over the Sales-to-delivery handover and make capacity visible enough that Sales doesn't promise what delivery can't back up
  • Months 3–4 — define what "first value" means for an enterprise account, and the timeframe we hold ourselves to
  • Months 4–6 — turn what you've learned into the first delivery playbook, and bring at least two validated product-market-fit findings back to Product and Sales

Requirements

  • 4–6 years in technical implementation, delivery, project lead or technical operations roles, at a B2B company serving manufacturing or industrial customers
  • Experience as an early hire building implementation or delivery processes from scratch in a startup or scale-up
  • Experience owning the interface between Sales and a technical delivery team: handover, capacity oversight, and escalations you resolved independently
  • Enough technical depth to get fluent fast in discrete manufacturing, factory planning or industrial automation. You don't need to have done this exact thing before, but you do need to hold a credible conversation with a manufacturing engineer within a few months
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English. We work in English internally; customer work happens in German

You're eligible to work in Germany — EU/EEA citizenship, or an existing work or residence permit. We aren't able to sponsor visas for this role.

You'll fit if:

  • You're decisive and comfortable holding your ground when Sales pushes on scope or timeline — and just as good at negotiating a pragmatic trade-off without compromising commitments already made
  • You're pragmatic and action-first: you build the process as the pattern emerges, rather than designing the system before you understand the reality
  • You have commercial instinct: you notice what's working and bring it to Sales as an expansion opportunity
  • You're a fast learner with strong situational awareness, equally comfortable on a shop floor and in front of a senior stakeholder

Benefits

  • Real ESOP — actual shares, not virtual ones
  • 30 days' holiday
  • Deutschlandticket
  • Based in our Düsseldorf office, with the flexibility to work from home
  • Regular customer site visits — a genuine mix of factory floor and desk, not travel every week
  • Real ownership from day one, with a direct line to founders and leadership on decisions that matter
  • The chance to define what this function becomes as we grow
  • A diverse, international team

Apply with your CV — no cover letter needed.

How the process runs:

  1. Short intro call — 30 minutes
  2. Written questions by email — about 20 minutes of your time
  3. Deep-dive with Felix and the delivery team — 60 minutes
  4. Meet the team, then offer

The written questions are how we get to know how you think before anyone sits in a room. They're the reason we don't ask for a cover letter.

We are an employer that actively lives equal opportunity. We're committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. It doesn't matter where you're from, what religion you belong to, your gender, who you love, how old you are, or whether you live with a disability — you're welcome here.

Questions about the role? Write to Amanda Graham

title: Senior Android Engineer- Hardware
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at SumUp
description_html:
Team description

The Hardware tribe builds the technology that turns everyday devices into secure, reliable card readers, from Bluetooth-connected dongles to fully in-house Tap to Pay on Android. You'll join a team solving genuinely hard problems: keeping payments working across flaky Bluetooth connections, handling online and offline flows without losing a transaction. It's a chance to go deep on Android engineering in a space where reliability really matters, since every merchant depends on these readers to get paid.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain Android applications for card readers, SDKs, and the SuperApp, covering both new features and improvements to existing systems

  • Work on Bluetooth Low Energy connections, online and offline payment flows, and Tap to Pay functionality

  • Refactor and modernise legacy code to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability

  • Contribute to testing practices, including unit and integration tests, to raise overall code quality

  • Collaborate with peers and stakeholders across the team to manage priorities and shape solutions to technical challenges

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Several years of professional Android development experience, with solid proficiency in both Java and Kotlin

  • Strong knowledge of clean architecture principles and hands-on experience maintaining Android SDKs

  • Experience of writing unit and integration tests, and comfort refactoring legacy code without breaking existing functionality

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions, and an interest in improving build and release processes

  • Ability to adapt to ambiguity and shifting priorities, with strong communication skills for working independently with stakeholders

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

About the team

SumUp's Point of Sale (POS) solution helps cafes, shops, bars, hair salons, and thousands of other businesses manage their day-to-day operations. Alongside the POS experience, merchants rely on powerful reporting, sales management, and fiscalisation tools to understand their business, stay compliant, and operate with confidence.

This role would own these three domains from a design perspective - Reporting, Sales, and Fiscalisation. You'll design the experiences merchants use to analyse performance, manage sales activity, and navigate local fiscal requirements, while helping shape a more unified reporting experience across SumUp's payments, banking, and commerce products.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and data teams within POS, and collaborate with designers and stakeholders across SumUp to deliver experiences that are clear, trustworthy, and built to scale.

🎬 Take a look at our Berlin office

  • Drive the unification of reporting experiences across Dashboard and Mobile, making complex data clear and accessible for merchants
  • Design holistic flows - including sign-up, onboarding, and export experiences, that meet local regulatory requirements while remaining scalable globally
  • Establish UX patterns for presenting data-heavy, financial information consistently across SumUp products
  • Shape long-term product strategy by running discovery initiatives, influencing the roadmap, and acting as a trusted design partner for product and engineering

  • You have solid experience designing dashboards, reporting interfaces, or analytics products, with a clear ability to make complex financial or operational data understandable for non-expert users.
  • You have deep expertise in product  design, information architecture, and systems thinking, applied across interconnected product ecosystems.
  • You have a track record of leading product discovery independently - from identifying user problems through to validating and shipping solutions, without needing close supervision.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at SumUp
description_html:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift
  • Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike
  • Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly
  • Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

 

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches

SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

title: Senior Product Owner - Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Yepoda
description_html:
About Yepoda

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

 

We are looking for a Senior Data & Analytics Product Owner to join our growing Data team at Yepoda. In this role, you will partner closely with our Head of Data & Technology to shape how we build and ship data and analytics products across the business — driving alignment with stakeholders, prototyping ideas hands-on, and making sure our data capabilities translate into real commercial outcomes.

 

Your Tasks

  • Own the company-wide analytics function, i.e., the KPI framework, reporting cadence, BI tooling/glossary, and our decision-support and reporting standards.

  • Own the product delivery roadmap for data initiatives for Yepoda's central Data analytics team.

  • Translate commercial questions (CAC/LTV, channel mix, contribution margin, cohort behaviour, inventory turnover, etc.) from Marketing, Operations, Finance and other functions into scoped, prioritized data products and repeatable analyses.

  • Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that data engineering and analytics teams can execute against without ambiguity. Be the person who closes the gap between "the business wants something" and "the team knows what to build."

  • Lead discovery and drive experimentation with stakeholders for new data capabilities, from self-serve analytics tooling to ML-powered features.

     

Your Profile

  • 3-5 years in a product management or product owner role in BI or Analytics or closely adjacent role at a relevant D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brand.

  • Strong business understanding, you think in terms of impact, not just output. Deep understanding of D2C metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, CIR/ROAS, contribution margin, cohort analytics, marketing attribution, etc).

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to operate at C-level, translating fuzzy commercial questions into sharp, defensible analyses

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving fast in a startup environment. You create structure rather than waiting for it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

 

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to modern data stack concepts (data warehouses, Self-Serve Analytics tools, ML pipelines); you don't need to build them, but knowing the landscape helps.

  • Experience writing SQL or working directly with data and AI tools such as Omni and Claude.

 

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

     

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.
