description_html:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

AI Operations Specialist

Salary range: €70,000-90,000/annum

We are seeking an exceptionally driven and entrepreneurial AI Operations Specialist to work directly with our leadership team, leading and building large-scale strategic projects from the ground up at Almedia. This isn't a classic job; it's a pivotal role for someone ready to commit fully to delivering significant impact, pushing boundaries, and seeing their ideas come to life.


In addition to leading core strategic initiatives, this role carries a strong AI focus. We are looking for someone operationally excellent but also technically strong and hands-on - a hard worker who can actively drive and execute AI initiatives across teams. You will not only shape strategy but also help translate AI opportunities into practical implementation, ensuring measurable business impact.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Lead high-priority projects: Take full ownership of key projects from start to finish, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with company goals.

  • Drive AI initiatives across the organisation: Identify, scope, and execute AI-driven projects that improve operational efficiency, user acquisition performance, product innovation, and decision-making processes. Act as the bridge between business needs and technical execution.

  • Develop a deep understanding of the business: Engage with all aspects of the company, from user acquisition to product development, to gain a comprehensive view of how the business operates - and identify where AI can unlock leverage.

  • Facilitate cross-departmental coordination: Ensure smooth communication and alignment between internal teams on objectives, timelines, resource needs, and AI project implementation.

  • Optimise operational efficiency: Identify and implement strategies including automation and AI-driven workflows to enhance productivity and streamline processes.


What You’ll Bring 💡

  • Experience in project management, operations, user acquisition, business development, business strategy, or AI-driven initiatives.

  • You're absolutely obsessed with AI and spend every minute you can researching and exploring the latest news and tools.

  • Ability to lead and execute projects independently, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.

  • Strong business acumen with a solid understanding of business operations, product development, and user acquisition.

  • Hands-on mindset with the capability to translate AI concepts into practical execution (e.g., automation, AI tools, data workflows, experimentation).

  • Analytical mindset: Able to extract insights from data and make strategic decisions based on business intelligence.

  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating across departments and with the leadership team.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

description_html:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

About the Role

Create beautiful, fast, and intuitive interfaces for A1.

You'll focus on the visual design of our products, ensuring every screen is clear, polished, and easy to use. Working alongside Product Designers and engineers, you'll bring the user experience to life through exceptional interface design.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design high-quality user interfaces

  • Build and maintain UI components and design systems.

  • Refine layouts, typography, spacing, and visual consistency.

  • Work closely with product and engineering to deliver pixel-perfect experiences.

  • Continuously improve the quality of the product interface.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating UI design work.

  • Excellent visual design, typography, and layout skills.

  • Experience building and maintaining design systems.

  • Proficiency with Figma.

  • Strong attention to detail and craftsmanship.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally.

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design challenge.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Solution Architect
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Taktile
description_html:
About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. As we grow with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, their architecture questions get harder: How does Taktile fit into an existing, complex and some-times decades-old core banking system landscape? How do we design for their security, availability, compliance, and integration requirements? Who speaks the language of their enterprise architects?

That's this role. As Solution Architect, you are a senior technical voice in our customer conversations - a sparring partner to enterprise architects at large financial institutions, helping them design how Taktile fits into their broader solution architecture.

What You'll Do as Solution Architect

  • Act as the trusted architecture counterpart for enterprise architects and technical leadership on the customer side — from first pre-sales conversations through large-scale production deployments.

  • Design the target solution architecture for enterprise transformations: how Taktile integrates into the customer's existing landscape of core systems, data platforms, and surrounding services, and how that architecture evolves over a multi-year journey.

  • Own the hardest architecture questions in our deals — integration patterns, deployment models, throughput, latency, security, compliance, data residency — and turn them from blockers into reasons to buy.

  • Lead architecture workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and reference architecture reviews with customer stakeholders from engineers up to CTOs.

  • Represent Taktile in senior architecture discussions on the customer side, giving their enterprise architects and technical leadership a credible, expert counterpart.

  • Build reusable reference architectures, integration blueprints, and best practices that scale across the Forward Deployed Engineering and Sales teams.

  • Work across pre-sales and post-sales: supporting Account Executives and Solution Engineers on complex enterprise deals, and partnering with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure what was sold is what gets built.

About You

  • You bring 10+ years of experience in solution or enterprise architecture, with significant time spent working directly with large enterprises — ideally in financial services.

  • You have deep, hands-on knowledge of AWS and enterprise integration patterns (event-driven architectures, messaging, APIs, batch, streaming), and you know when to use which.

  • You've worked with enterprise-grade legacy systems — core banking platforms, loan origination systems (LOSs), loan management systems (LMS), front-end SDKs, mainframes, on-prem estates — and know what it actually takes to integrate a modern SaaS platform into them.

  • You have a solid grounding in security and compliance as they apply to regulated enterprises: authentication and authorization patterns, network architecture, encryption, data residency, and audit requirements.

  • You hold your own with the most senior technical stakeholders on the customer side — enterprise architects, Heads of Engineering, CTOs — and are seen as a peer, not a vendor.

  • You communicate complex architecture crisply, in writing, on a whiteboard, in a slide deck, and in the room, to both deeply technical and executive audiences.

  • You're comfortable operating across pre-sales and post-sales, and you know how to make architecture decisions that are right for the customer and commercially sound.

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • You have experience as a Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Principal Consultant at a B2B SaaS company, cloud provider, or top-tier consultancy serving financial institutions.

  • You have designed architectures involving AI/ML or Generative AI workloads in production.

  • You hold relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, TOGAF).

  • You have experience responding to enterprise RFPs and security/architecture reviews.

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. description_html:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Platform team.

About the role

Our Engineering and Product Design teams are building multiple verticals on our platform at high speed, leveraging AI and building agentic functionality into the platform itself. As we scale into the world's largest regulated financial institutions, identity and access management (IAM), authorization, and fine-grained permissions have become foundational to our enterprise readiness.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to join the team building Taktile's IAM and permissions platform: the authorization backbone that powers enterprise-grade access control across our product.

Joining us, you'll design and build permission models and access controls end-to-end, from the React/TypeScript access-management and admin UIs down to the Python (FastAPI) authorization services. You'll take on the problems that make enterprise authorization genuinely hard: multi-tenant isolation, fine-grained permission checks in the hot path of millions of decisions a day, audit and access trails, and the constraints of regulated financial services.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate core authorization primitives such as roles, policies, and fine-grained permission checks (RBAC/ReBAC), along with the authentication and SSO/OAuth/OIDC flows that sit on top of them.

  • Guarantee strict multi-tenant isolation so every customer's data and decisions stay fully segregated.

  • Keep fine-grained permission checks fast in the hot path of millions of automated decisions per day, where both latency and correctness are non-negotiable.

  • Build audit and access-trail capabilities that give customers and auditors a verifiable record of who accessed what, when, and why.

  • Design for regulated-industry constraints (financial services, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, data residency), where access control is a compliance requirement, not just a feature.

  • Leverage leading edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to build industry-shaping AI-native capabilities.

Requirement:

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack experience building backend services in Python (FastAPI or equivalent), including REST APIs and databases

  • Strong proficiency with React and TypeScript.

  • Experience building access control systems, with exposure to authentication and authorization concepts (RBAC, SSO, OAuth/OIDC, multi-tenant permissions).

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

  • Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in a remote environment requiring clear and effective communication.

Nice, but not required

  • Deeper backend specialization (async patterns, performance tuning, data modeling).

  • DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy.

  • Hands-on experience designing authorization systems at scale: fine-grained / ReBAC models, policy engines (OpenFGA or Zanzibar-style systems, OPA), or multi-tenant RBAC for enterprise SaaS.

  • Prior ops or on-call experience.

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) at Cohere, you will drive revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and nurturing high-potential leads for our enterprise AI solutions. You’ll act as the first point of contact for prospects, understanding their business needs and aligning them with Cohere’s products to solve complex challenges like natural language processing, AI integration, and scalable language models. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell cutting-edge IP, that is being newly productised, within your own book of business.

  • Proactively research and identify target accounts across region in industries such as finance, technology, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector, etc. using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and CRM platforms to prioritise high-fit prospects.

  • Qualify leads using the BANT framework (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) and document interactions in Salesforce, ensuring a clean and actionable pipeline for the sales team.

  • Collaborate with marketing to refine messaging and campaigns based on prospect feedback, contributing to a 15%+ improvement in campaign response rates.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and Cohere’s product roadmap to position our solutions effectively and anticipate customer needs.

title: Global Director of Revenue Enablement (Remote Europe or East Coast)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at N8N
description_html:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Location: Remote — Europe or US East Coast (Virginia, New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Florida only)

🎯 Your main goal will be to build n8n's global revenue enablement engine — installing one enterprise selling methodology across every region, compressing ramp for every revenue team worldwide, and turning our community-led momentum into repeatable 7–8 figure enterprise revenue.

You'll report directly to our senior commercial leadership, inherit a small enablement team with basic onboarding in place, and have the mandate (and explicit VP trajectory) to build the function from the ground up: for a remote-first company selling across EMEA, the US, and beyond.

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

METHODOLOGY & ENTERPRISE SELLING EXCELLENCE

  • Own the global install of one enterprise methodology (MEDDICC / value-selling framework): selection, rollout, certification, and continuous reinforcement across every rep and manager, in every region.

  • Build the PLG-to-enterprise playbook: teach sellers to convert community and self-serve signals into qualified 7-figure pipeline.

  • Partner with PMM and Product to arm the field with AI-led narratives, competitive plays, and launch enablement.

RAMP, ONBOARDING & MANAGER DEVELOPMENT

  • Build one global onboarding engine, pre-boarding through certification to first-deal support, and compress time-to-quota for hiring waves in every region.

  • Develop frontline sales managers: coaching frameworks, deal inspection, and forecast rigor that make the methodology stick.

  • Define enablement's scorecard in revenue terms: ramp time, win rate, forecast accuracy, not course completions.

BUILDING THE GLOBAL FUNCTION

  • Lead and grow the enablement team (starting with 1–2 ICs) across sales, SDR, CS, and partner enablement.

  • Stand up the enablement infrastructure: tooling, content systems, certification tracking, and measurement with RevOps.

  • Operate as a trusted peer to regional sales leaders across EMEA, the US, and future markets: in deal rooms, QBRs, and forecast reviews.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🚀 Hypergrowth pedigree: You built enablement at a developer-tool, open-source, or technical B2B SaaS company as it scaled enterprise.

  • 📈 €xm→€1bn scaling: You grew the function through a major GTM headcount wave and constant evolution of sales maturity. You've solved ramp at volume, not maintained steady-state.

  • 🧠 Methodology implementation owner: You've run a company-wide MEDDICC / Command of the Message-style install end-to-end, with certification and reinforcement that stuck.

  • ⏱️ Ramp engineer: You've built onboarding programs with measurable time-to-productivity compression.

  • 📊 Revenue-outcome mindset: You measure enablement in deal size, win rate, ramp time, and forecast accuracy.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🎖️ Methodology-firm pedigree: Force Management, or similar as a consultant or a certified in-house champion.

  • 💼 Carried a bag: You sold enterprise deals yourself, so reps and leaders trust you in deal conversations.

  • 🌱 PLG-to-enterprise: You've enabled teams converting community/self-serve momentum into enterprise revenue.

  • 🤖 AI narrative: You've positioned AI/ML-driven products in enterprise settings and think of an AI first solution to solving problems.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into an LMS. You'll build the global enablement function at the exact moment we scale from community-led momentum into 7–8 figure enterprise deals - the moment enablement leaders at MongoDB or HashiCorp will tell you was the best of their career. You'll install the methodology worldwide, set one ramp standard across regions, develop managers on every continent we sell in, and grow the team, with a direct line to senior commercial leadership and an explicit path to VP. You'll join a fast-growing, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

 

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

  • Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

  • Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

  • Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

  • Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

  • Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

  • Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

  • Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

  • Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

  • Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

  • Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

🎯 Your main goal will be to become n8n's dedicated architect of Partner Ecosystem strategy and operations, building the systems, data, and processes that let this fast-growing partner network scale alongside n8n's growth.

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

Channel Program Operations

  • Own the operational infrastructure powering n8n's global partner ecosystem across reseller and referral segments.

  • Design and maintain partner-attributed pipeline tracking, keeping sourced, influenced, and co-sell deals accurately categorized in Salesforce.

  • Build and maintain channel reporting frameworks covering partner-sourced MRR, activation rates, deal registration, and tier performance.

Partner Performance & Pipeline

  • Support partner pipeline inspection and forecast roll-ups alongside Channel Sales leadership.

  • Develop reporting and insights that drive partner growth and sharpen program performance.

  • Build channel-specific territory and routing logic so partner-sourced leads and registered deals are prioritized and attributed correctly.

Program & Systems Administration

  • Own configuration and adoption of partner-facing tools, including the partner portal and Salesforce's channel-specific objects.

  • Maintain documentation and training materials covering channel processes, rules of engagement, and partner program policies.

  • Manage partner tier qualification, tracking certifications and activity thresholds, while using AI-enabled tools to streamline and scale the work.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Channel Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to operationalize GTM motions like co-marketing campaigns and partner enablement launches.

  • Serve as the channel operations subject matter expert across cross-functional planning cycles, from annual planning to QBRs and GTM launches.

  • Triage and support ad hoc requests, partner escalations, and troubleshooting as they come up.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎯 Channel/Partner Ops experience: You bring 5+ years in Sales Operations or Channel/Partner Operations at a technology company, ideally supporting partner or indirect revenue programs in a high-growth SaaS environment.

  • 🤝 Channel program know-how: You understand channel mechanics like deal registration, partner tiering, co-sell motions, referral fee structures, and margin/discount governance.

  • ⚙️ Salesforce & channel tech stack: You're proficient in Salesforce objects, relationships, and reporting - including channel-specific objects - and you've worked with tools like PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or partner portals.

  • 📊 Data & analytics chops: You're highly proficient in Google Sheets or Excel and comfortable with BI tools, turning partner data into clear insights on contribution and pipeline attribution.

  • 🔍 Precision & attention to detail: You bring meticulous organization and hold your own work to a high standard of accuracy.

  • 🔄 Change management: You've led org-wide change before, especially when operationalizing new program structures.

  • 🧩 Problem-solving mindset: You spot operational gaps quickly and build scalable solutions that move the needle on efficiency and outcomes.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🏅 Salesforce Admin certification: You hold a Salesforce Admin certification, or you're close to earning one.

  • 💻 SQL proficiency: You're comfortable writing SQL queries to dig into partner and pipeline data yourself.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll be a founding voice in how we scale our partner motion - shaping the systems, data, and processes behind a channel strategy that's still being built from the ground up. You'll work closely with Partner leadership and the broader RevOps team, with the autonomy to drive initiatives end-to-end and the visibility that comes with being a first dedicated hire in this space. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, inside one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Head of People Ops & Tech

🎯 You'll own and rebuild the operating system behind n8n's People function: hygiene, analytics, systems, and automation. This isn't a maintenance job. You'll have a real mandate to design it your way, and since n8n builds workflow automation for a living, you'll get to use our own product to do it. If you've ever wanted to turn your own function into your best case study, this is that job.

You're inheriting a People Ops team that's kept things moving through real growth, and you'll get a proper audit period before anyone asks you to change anything. That's real trust, and it means you get to diagnose before you prescribe.

Here's what you'll own:

Own the hygiene factors of employment

  • Own employment contracts, payroll coordination, visas, and employee policies end to end.

  • Keep n8n's SOC 2-related compliance processes accurate and audit-ready.

  • Bring clear, centralized ownership to freelancer and contractor engagement approvals, an area with no consistent oversight today.

  • Personally step in on hands-on hygiene work whenever it's the highest-impact use of your time.

Build people analytics in-house

  • Stand up n8n's own people analytics capability rather than relying on the central data team, given the sensitivity of the data.

  • Turn People data into decisions leadership can act on, from attrition trends to org health.

  • Report on the health of the People function to the VP People and wider leadership.

Own people systems and drive automation

  • Own and evolve People systems like HiBob and Mahana, keeping data clean and workflows scalable.

  • Automate repetitive People Ops work, partnering with workflow automation engineers on the most complex builds. You'll be doing it with n8n's own product, so you get to dogfood the exact tool your company sells, on your own function.

  • Get the underlying process and data right before you automate it. Solid documentation and a consistent process come first here, not as an afterthought.

  • Reduce manual load so the function scales without headcount growing in lockstep.

Welcome new hires and grow the team

  • Act as the onboarding liaison, making sure new hires feel welcomed and set up to succeed from day one.

  • Build out a small, high-trust team, hiring 2–3 specialists in analytics, automation, and systems over the next 12–24 months.

  • Partner closely with the VP People, Talent Acquisition, People Partners, and Finance/Legal to keep People Operations reliable as we scale.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📈 Proven scaling experience: You've scaled or matured an existing People Operations function, not necessarily built one from zero, through a comparable growth range such as 500 to 1,000 employees.

  • 📝 Hands-on hygiene ownership: You've personally owned contracts, payroll coordination, visas, employee policies, and SOC 2-adjacent compliance, not just directed others who do.

  • ⚖️ Strategic and hands-on: You're comfortable setting vision and prioritizing, and just as comfortable rolling up your sleeves on execution.

  • 📊 People analytics fluency: You have real experience with people analytics and data, and you're willing to build that capability in-house.

title: On Holiday Support Agent
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at loveholidays
description_html:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

description_html:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN US

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a People Operations Specialist, you'll help build the operational foundation that enables our teams to thrive as we grow internationally. Your work will ensure our people processes are efficient, scalable, and employee-centric.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Coordinate day-to-day people operations so everything runs smoothly across regions.

  • Manage the administration of key employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, etc.) and keep improving how they work.

  • Spot inefficiencies and suggest practical improvements that align with business priorities.

  • Use tools and systems to simplify people processes and make them more scalable.

  • Work closely with teams across the business to drive projects from start to finish.

  • Maintain clear SOPs and policies so people processes are consistent across locations.

  • Resolve day-to-day people queries around people topics

  • Partner effectively with external providers (payroll, benefits, etc.) to ensure smooth and reliable service delivery.

  • Track compliance and manage risks across the regions you support.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Leading with empathy and sensitivity

  • Advanced knowledge of HRIS systems, particularly HiBob

  • Ability to handle complex projects, strong analytical skills, and attention to detail

  • Familiarity with AI-driven workflows and continuous improvement methodologies

  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information in a professional manner

  • Fluent German language skills

INTERVIEW PROCESS

It suits people with five to seven years sourcing complex technical systems.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own procurement for integrated systems, manufacturing equipment and supplier-designed technical packages.

  • Develop sourcing strategies and identify the best suppliers for complex engineering systems such as cryogenic systems, fuel cycle, vacuum systems, plant electrical supply, cooling, instrumentation/control/data, plasma heating and diagnostics.

  • Lead RFIs, RFPs and supplier negotiations from market assessment through contract award.

  • Define commercial agreements covering performance, warranties, documentation, acceptance testing and lifecycle support.

  • Work closely with Engineering to manage supplier interfaces, technical risks and delivery milestones.

  • Manage interfaces between technical packages and suppliers, ensuring system-level performance requirements, integration responsibilities and acceptance criteria are clearly defined.

  • Support contract execution by managing supplier performance, change requests and commercial risks.

  • Improve procurement processes using digital tools and AI to simplify sourcing and decision-making.

  • Around 5–7 years of experience in procurement, supplier management or strategic sourcing.

  • Comfortable working with technical specifications, system interfaces and acceptance testing and able to adapt to constant changes.

  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills.

  • You switch cleanly between strategic thinking and execution mode, navigating multi-stakeholder environments with ease and bringing professionalism to everything you touch

  • Degree in Engineering or a related field.

title: Laser Diagnostician

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Laser Aided Plasma diagnostician you will be designing and building some of the most important diagnostics on the Alpha stellarator. This role provides a unique opportunity to work alongside other diagnostic experts, software engineers, fusion scientists, and fusion engineers, making a tangible impact on the future of clean energy. The role will require the management of the full product lifecycle of this important diagnostic form conception, through design, review, testing, installation, calibration, operation and maintenance on the Alpha stellarator.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead the design and build of the Thomson Scattering (TS) diagnostic to be deployed on the Alpha stellarator to measure spatial profiles of electron density and temperature.

  • Lead the design and build of the plasma density diagnostic to be deployed on the Alpha stellarator to measure the line integrated electron density using a laser based two colour or dispersion interferometer.

  • Develop a detailed diagnostic specification able deliver the measurement performance required.

  • Work with the engineering team on Alpha to establish a robust implementation of the TS and plasma density diagnostics.

  • Prepare and execute plans for all the steps required to implement the diagnostic and bring it into operations: design, procure, build, test, install, commission, calibrate, operate and maintain.

  • Oversee and undertake/delegate/subcontract packages of work as part of the plan to ensure successful completion of the laser based diagnostics.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A Master’s degree or higher in physics, engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Have experience using class IV lasers: a high energy (Joule level) pulsed lasers and/or high power CW infra-red single longitudinal mode lasers.

  • Have worked on at least one laser based diagnostic instrument on a large infrastructure machine (accelerator, telescope, laser or fusion device)

  • Strong knowledge of geometric optics and light propagation in optical systems.

  • Experience of designing and building a Thomson scattering system and or an interferometer for a plasma device would be an advantage.

  • Working knowledge of Python software development and modern tool chains (uv, git etc.)

  • Experience using optical design software for ray-tracing would be an advantage

title: Plasma Microwave Modelling Physicist (ECRH, Gyrotrons)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Proxima Fusion GmbH
description_html:
Proxima Fusion is hiring an Alpha Plasma Microwave Modeler in Munich to own the physics simulation pipeline connecting our gyrotron sources to plasma performance. You will model the propagation, polarization and absorption of millimeter waves in the Alpha stellarator, running ray-tracing and beam-tracing codes such as TRAVIS and RAYTRAX and validating against W7-X experimental data to drive the design of the Alpha ECRH launcher. You will model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive and build Python post-processing pipelines. It suits physicists with hands-on experience of an EC propagation or absorption code.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run ray-tracing and beam-tracing simulations of EC wave propagation and absorption using codes such as TRAVIS, RAYTRAX and more complex beam or full wave model codes

  • Develop an integrated modeling framework that couples wave deposition to transport codes, enabling temperature and density profile optimization and validation of the heating scenario performance

  • Build and maintain Python-based post-processing pipelines to automate scenario scanning and interface simulation outputs with the Alpha integrated design framework

  • Model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive (ECCD) and assess its ability to modify rotational transform and equilibrium in the Alpha quasi-isodynamic configuration

  • Contribute to design reviews, interface control documents, and technical reports to ensure simulation results are traceable and actionable

WHO YOU ARE

  • PhD (or equivalent demonstrated expertise) in plasma physics, applied physics, or a related field, with a focus on plasma-wave interactions or RF heating of magnetically confined plasmas

  • Hands-on experience with at least one EC propagation or absorption code (TRAVIS, TORBEAM, C3PO, IPF-FD3D, or similar)

  • Proficiency in Python for simulation scripting, data analysis, and visualization; comfort reading and modifying legacy Fortran or C/C++ code

  • Systems-thinking mindset: able to translate physics outputs into engineering requirements and hardware constraints

  • Strong team player, comfortable working across physics and engineering disciplines and with external academic partners

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own and build the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for Alpha, Proxima Fusion’s first fusion demonstrator.

  • Define the scheduling architecture, coding structure, baseline conventions, and reporting standards from the ground up.

  • Integrate sub-schedules across infrastructure, plant suppliers, manufacturing, and machine engineering into one coherent programme view.

  • Establish credible milestones, programme gates, dependencies, and schedule interfaces across all workstreams.

  • Identify, validate, and maintain the programme’s critical and near-critical paths.

  • Provide early warning of schedule risk, emerging delays, and downstream impacts.

  • Run schedule analysis to support recovery planning, mitigation actions, and informed trade-off decisions.

  • Maintain the IMS as a live, accurate, and trusted programme-management tool.

  • Support PMO governance, release-gate decisions, and executive programme reviews.

  • Provide clear schedule insights and recommendations to programme leadership as Alpha scales.

  • Drive schedule discipline and alignment across internal teams, suppliers, and delivery partners.

  • Ensure the programme has a defensible plan against which progress, performance, and readiness can be measured.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build / advance the Alpha IMS architecture: WBS structure, activity coding, baseline conventions, and schedule governance rules that work across infrastructure, manufacturing, and machine disciplines

  • Consolidate sub-schedules from all workstreams - including facility and plant construction, specialist equipment suppliers, and machine engineering - into one integrated baseline; enforce scheduling standards with internal project owners and external delivery partners

  • Maintain a lean 6-week rolling lookahead as a live, actionable planning tool for the PMO and construction governance stream

  • Identify and continuously update the critical path; model schedule impacts from scope changes, design evolution, or supplier delays before they reach senior leadership as surprises

  • Own the schedule input to release gate decisions: prepare schedule status packs, flag float consumption, and present risk-adjusted scenarios to the management.

  • Define and enforce scheduling standards - including building and plant construction partners, and other specialist disciplines who provide delivery schedules as inputs to the IMS

  • Work in lockstep with the Cost Controller so that schedule baseline and cost forecast always reflect the same program assumptions; support integrated change impact assessments

  • Support the development of the PMO's broader project controls framework as the team builds out

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in integrated schedule management on major capital programs - energy, industrial, research infrastructure, or similarly complex multi-discipline projects; experience spanning both building construction and equipment/plant supply chains is strongly preferred

  • Capable of building an IMS architecture from scratch, not just maintaining an inherited baseline - you know what a good schedule looks like before it exists and can get there from incomplete inputs

  • Technically proficient in scheduling tools for large-scale complex projects; comfortable working with federated schedule inputs from parties using different tools and conventions

  • Able to hold the line on schedule discipline with internal engineers and external partners who have their own priorities - you combine analytical rigour with the communication skills to make schedule governance stick

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy in an environment where program structure is still being built; define the working framework without waiting to be told how

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the contractor and regulatory landscape

  • Familiar with AI tools and digital working methods; you adapt fast and are comfortable in a lean, high-pace environment

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)


*This role sits at "L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Health and Safety Lead (HSE)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Proxima Fusion GmbH
description_html:
Proxima Fusion is hiring a Health and Safety Manager in Munich to own our Health and Safety strategy and operations across our sites in Munich, Switzerland and the UK. You will own and improve the H&S framework across all locations, developing company-wide policies, procedures, standards and management systems. You will keep us compliant with applicable German, Swiss and UK health and safety regulations, harmonise safety processes across laboratories, workshops and technical facilities, and lead risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. NEBOSH, IOSH or SiFa is ideal.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and continuously improve Proxima Fusion’s Health & Safety framework across all company locations

  • Develop, implement, and maintain company-wide H&S policies, procedures, standards, and management systems

  • Ensure compliance with applicable German, Swiss, and UK health and safety regulations

  • Coordinate best practices and harmonize safety processes across laboratories, workshops, office environments, and technical facilities

  • Lead risk assessments, incident investigations, root cause analyses, and corrective action programs

  • Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and compliance reviews across all locations

  • Partner with facilities and technical teams on safe design, commissioning, and operation of laboratories, workshops, and experimental infrastructure

  • Support contractor management, permit-to-work systems, and safe working procedures

  • Develop and deliver H&S training, onboarding, emergency response exercises, and awareness programs

  • Build a proactive and positive safety culture through coaching, engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Maintain accurate H&S records, reporting dashboards, and regulatory documentation

  • Act as the primary point of contact for external inspectors, auditors, and regulatory bodies

  • Advise leadership on strategic H&S priorities, risks, and mitigation plans

  • Support business continuity and emergency preparedness planning across all sites

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have significant experience in Health & Safety leadership roles within engineering, manufacturing, laboratory, industrial, deep-tech, energy, or research environments

  • You have strong knowledge of European and/or UK occupational health and safety regulations and standards

  • You are experienced in building and scaling H&S systems across multiple sites or international operations

  • You are confident operating in fast-moving and highly technical environments

  • You have hands-on experience with risk assessments, audits, incident investigations, and safety training

  • You are an excellent communicator who can influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation

  • You are pragmatic, organised, and solutions-oriented

  • You enjoy building processes from the ground up and driving continuous improvement

  • You are willing to travel periodically between Proxima Fusion sites

  • Ideally you possess NEBOSH Diploma, IOSH certification, or equivalent H&S qualification. eg. knowledge of German occupational safety frameworks (SiFa)

  • Ideally you have experience in laboratory safety, cryogenics, high-voltage systems, radiation safety, or advanced manufacturing environments

  • Ideally you have experience supporting construction, facility build-outs, or technical infrastructure projects

  • Ideally you are familiar with ISO management systems and audit frameworks

  • German language skills are preferred.

title: Senior Recruiter, Manufacturing
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Proxima Fusion GmbH
description_html:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Recruiter, you'll join Proxima Fusion's Talent Acquisition team, reporting into our Recruiter lead, at a moment when we're scaling on two fronts at once: growing our deep-tech engineering and science teams, and building out the manufacturing workforce behind Alpha and Stellaris.

You'll take full ownership of complex, often niche searches, act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, and help shape how the TA team hires for manufacturing and industrial roles alongside our technical hiring. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants more scope and more say in how we build the function, without stepping away from the recruiting itself.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and execute full-cycle recruitment for critical roles, with a focus on manufacturing roles.

  • Lead recruitment for manufacturing and production roles as we ramp up facilities — technicians, operators, quality and manufacturing engineers — building sourcing channels beyond the usual technical hiring playbook.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers, including senior technical and manufacturing leaders, to define hiring needs and build tailored sourcing strategies that go well beyond LinkedIn.

  • Drive top-of-funnel strategy: proactively source and engage exceptional passive talent, in German and English, via recruitment events, conferences, and talent communities across the DACH region and beyond.

  • Act as a senior voice within the TA team: mentor junior recruiters, share sourcing craft, and help set the bar for what good looks like.

  • Champion an outstanding candidate experience at every touchpoint, adapting your approach for very different audiences — from a senior scientist to a shop-floor hire.

  • Contribute to TA projects beyond your own reqs: improving workflows and tooling, building out our German-market employer brand, or delivering interview training.

  • Help the Head of Talent Acquisition build a high-trust, high-rigor process that supports scaling without compromising on quality.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are a or professional-fluency German speaker with full professional fluency in English, and you're comfortable recruiting and building relationships in both languages.

  • You bring several years of hands-on, full-cycle recruitment experience in a startup or scale-up, ideally spanning both technical and manufacturing/industrial hiring.

  • You have experience recruiting internationally for niche and difficult-to-fill roles, and are used to working with very selective, technically demanding hiring teams.

  • You have direct exposure to hiring for manufacturing, production, or industrial operations roles, and understand how that differs from hiring engineers or scientists.

  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments and take ownership seriously.

  • You're deeply motivated by quality — your standards are high and you won't settle for less.

  • You have exceptional sourcing instincts and know how to identify talent others might overlook.

  • You think outside the box on sourcing and attraction, using LinkedIn as one tool among many — including events, talent communities, and conferences.

  • You're organized, autonomous, and eager to improve the systems and processes that let a TA team scale.

  • You communicate clearly, act decisively, and work well with demanding stakeholders.

  • You're genuinely excited to help build something audacious from the ground up, and to help shape a growing TA team along the way.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30–45 min)

  • Panel Interviews (3 rounds, 60 min each)

This role sits at L3 of our framework; please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

title: C-Entwickler (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Everfield
description_html:
C-Entwickler (m/w/d) – Systemnahe Windows- und Storage-Entwicklung

Festanstellung, Vollzeit | Remote möglich (Deutschland), bevorzugt Raum Regensburg

Über Everfield

Everfield ist auf den Erwerb, die Entwicklung und den Ausbau von europäischen Software-Unternehmen in unterschiedlichen Märkten spezialisiert. Wir stellen unseren Unternehmen jegliche strategischen Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um auf die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu gelangen. Unsere Mission ist es, ambitionierte Visionen zu verwirklichen, nachhaltiges Wachstum zu fördern und neue Chancen im europäischen Software-Ökosystem zu erschließen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem bewahren ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte, um sich gezielt auf ihre Kernkompetenzen zu konzentrieren: die Entwicklung innovativer Produkte und die umfassende Betreuung ihrer Kunden. Everfield bietet dabei gezielte Unterstützung in den Bereichen Personalgewinnung und HR sowie Zugang zu einem Expertenteam, das auf den Aufbau und das Wachstum europäischer B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen spezialisiert ist und in finanziellen sowie operativen Belangen berät. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2022 ist Everfield in 7 Ländern präsent – und wächst stetig weiter.

Über uns

ondeso ist ein führender Anbieter von OT-Administrationssoftware für die industrielle IT mit Sitz in Regensburg: Mit ondeso SR bieten wir Industrie-PCs eine zuverlässige, standardmäßig integrierte Backup-Lösung für Sicherungen ganz ohne Neustart oder Produktionsunterbrechung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen C-Entwickler (m/w/d), der diese Kerntechnologie systemnah und performancekritisch weiterentwickelt.

Deine Aufgaben:

· Weiterentwicklung und Wartung unseres Disk-Imaging-Kerns in C

· Systemnahe Arbeit im Umfeld von Windows-Kernel und Dateisystemen

· Sicherstellung von Stabilität und Datenintegrität bei laufenden/produktiven Systemen

· Weiterentwicklung sicherheitsrelevanter Komponenten (u. a. Verschlüsselung)

· Performance-Optimierung von speicher- und I/O-intensivem Code

· Enge Zusammenarbeit im Entwicklerteam bei Architekturentscheidungen für unsere Storage- und Backup-Lösung

Dein Profil:

· Mehrjährige Erfahrung in systemnaher C-Entwicklung

· Erfahrung mit Windows-Low-Level-Programmierung, z. B. im Umfeld von Kernel, Treibern oder Dateisystemen

· Fundiertes Verständnis von Speicherverwaltung und performancekritischem Code

· Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit laufenden/produktiven Systemen, bei denen Stabilität entscheidend ist

· Selbstständige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten

· Freude an technischer Tiefe statt an schnellem Feature-Stacking

· Kommunikationsstärke, auch remote und im kleinen Team

· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Nice-to-have:

· Erfahrung mit Storage- oder Backup-Software

· Kenntnisse in Kryptografie- bzw. Verschlüsselungsverfahren

· Erfahrung mit industriellen OT-Umgebungen oder Industrie-PCs

· Grundkenntnisse in Linux

· Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen (z. B. Azure, AWS)

Was wir bieten:

· Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, orientiert am Marktniveau für erfahrene Storage-/Systems-Spezialisten

· Remote-Arbeit möglich, idealerweise mit Sitz im Raum Regensburg – dort sitzen unser Büro und das Team, gelegentliche Präsenztage sind willkommen

· Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Gleitzeit

· Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Einarbeitung durch einen erfahrenen Kollegen

· Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

· Hohe Eigenverantwortung und direkter Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kerntechnologie

Bewerbungsprozess & Kontakt:

Passt dieses Profil zu dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Ansprechpartner/in: Karolina

Ablauf: In einem ersten, kurzen Screening-Gespräch (ca. 30 Minuten) lernst du unseren Talent Acquisition Lead Karolina kennen. Im zweiten Schritt führst du ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit Kathrin (ondeso HR) und Martin (ondeso CTO) (ca. 45 Minuten).
